Sem pressa. É a primeira parceira da sua.en: No rush. It's the first partner of your life: think it over!

Opa, chegou gente! Seja bem-vindo a Ping.en: Oh, we have company! Welcome to Pingorama! I'm Ipê Amarelo, but everyone calls me Prof. Ipê.

Esta terra é cheia de criaturas: no capi.en: This land is full of creatures: in the grass, in the rivers, in the caves, high up in the trees. We live with them, learn from them and, now and then, battle alongside them. Me? I study them all. Or I try to.

Mas antes de falar de bicho, me fale de.en: But before we talk critters, tell me about yourself.

{JOGADOR}! Nome bom de gritar no meio do.en: {JOGADOR}! A good name to shout across the bush. Well then, {JOGADOR}: your story in Pingorama starts now. And it starts the right way — late for breakfast.

{JOGADOR}! Acorda, criatura! O café está.en: {JOGADOR}! Wake up, sleepyhead! Breakfast is on the table and Prof. Ipê has already come by twice!

É o seu quarto, em Vila Jacarandá. O com.en: It's your room, in Vila Jacarandá. The computer is on and the stairs lead down to the kitchen.

Até que enfim, {JOGADOR}! Achei que você.en: Finally, {JOGADOR}! I thought you'd turned into a Preguicim. Prof. Ipê wants to see you at the lab. She said it's important — and she only says that about three times a day.

Antes de sair, leva isto. Chegou do cons.en: Before you go, take this. It came back from the repair shop this morning.

É o seu Rádio Cipó: pega os programas, g.en: It's your Rádio Cipó: it picks up the shows, keeps the contacts of everyone you meet and tells the time. Speaking of time… its clock got reset at the shop. What day is it again? And what time is it?

Isso! Eu sabia. Só estava testando você..en: That's it! I knew it. I was just testing you. I already saved the home number in your contacts. Call me now and then, okay? Moms are creatures that need attention too.

Ah, e mais uma coisa: quando você começa.en: Oh, one more thing: when you start earning patacas out there, I can keep some of it safe for you. Just ask. Now go, the professor is waiting. And comb that hair!

A Profª Ipê está no laboratório, descend.en: Prof. Ipê is at the lab, down the street and to the right. Go on, don't keep her waiting!

Senta aí, toma um suco de caju. As suas.en: Sit down, have some cashew juice. Your creatures too: there are cassava puffs for everyone.

Pronto! Vocês estão com outra cara. Juíz.en: There! You all look brand new. Be good out there!

Vem cá. Pronto. Agora vai conquistar o m.en: Come here. There. Now go conquer the world, but be back for Sunday lunch.

Cem espécies diferentes no Diário de Cam.en: A hundred different species in the Field Journal?! {JOGADOR}, not even I managed that at your age! I've kept something for years, waiting for someone who deserved it.

É uma Cuia Guardiã, obra dos antigos Gua.en: It's a Guardian Gourd, made by the ancient Guardians. It never fails. Only three exist in the whole world. Use it wisely: some creatures only show up once.

{JOGADOR}! Bem na hora. Quer dizer, atra.en: {JOGADOR}! Right on time. I mean, late, but right on your usual late time. I need a favor I can only ask of someone I trust.

Chegou às minhas mãos um ovo que eu nunc.en: An egg like none I've ever seen came into my hands: the Painted Egg. The egg expert on this coast is Seu Aroeira, over in Vila Caiçara. Someone has to take the egg to him. I'd go, but if I leave, Juca will mix up the samples again.

Só que a Trilha do Ipê é cheia de grama.en: The thing is, Trilha do Ipê is full of tall grass, and nobody crosses tall grass alone. See the three gourds on the table? Each holds a young creature I raised myself. One of them is going with you.

Chegue perto de cada cuia e examine. A c.en: Walk up to each gourd and take a look. The creature will introduce itself — they're show-offs. Take your time. Think it through: a partnership is for life!

As três cuias estão na mesa: Mata à esqu.en: The three gourds are on the table: Grass on the left, Ember in the middle, River on the right. Stand in front of each one, take a look and choose. Think it through!

O Seu Aroeira mora em Vila Caiçara, ao n.en: Seu Aroeira lives in Vila Caiçara, to the north, at the end of Trilha do Ipê. It's the big house that smells of coffee. Careful with the Painted Egg: no running with it under your arm!

O Diário de Campo anota sozinho cada cri.en: The Field Journal records every creature you meet on its own. The ones you catch get a complete entry. The first gym is in Vila Caiçara. Master Gaivota uses the Wind type: Thunder and Stone give him trouble.

Insígnia no estojo e criatura bem cuidad.en: A badge in the case and a well-cared-for creature: you're turning out better than I ordered! After Bosque Alto, head on to Porto Sereia. Captain Marola there is the one who gives out the Paddle Charm: the Costa do Sol continues by sea.

Três insígnias! Eu sabia que aquele atra.en: Three badges! I knew all that lateness was just you getting a running start. There are eight badges on the Costa do Sol, and after them the League of Guardians, on the Plateau. Only a League Champion can board for the Sertão das Névoas. The last badge is in Vila Buriti, where my colleague Dr. Buriti works. Tell her I said hi and that she owes me a book.

As outras duas cuias continuam na mesa,.en: The other two gourds are still on the table, waiting for their trainers.

Três cuias de cabaça entalhada, com tran.en: Three carved calabash gourds wrapped in woven straw. One of them just hopped. Better talk to Prof. Ipê before touching anything.

A mesa das três cuias. Para examinar uma.en: The table with the three gourds. To look at one, stand right in front of it.

A cuia da esquerda se abre: é o Tamanduí.en: The left gourd opens: it's Tamanduí, a little tamandua with leafy fur! Calm and cuddly, it hugs everything it sees. Grass-type creatures have the edge over River, Earth and Stone.

A cuia do meio se abre: é o Guaraxim, um.en: The middle gourd opens: it's Guaraxim, a maned wolf pup with a mane of embers! Skittish and proud, it warms up the whole room. Ember-type creatures have the edge over Grass, Frost, Bug and Iron.

A cuia da direita se abre: é o Botinho,.en: The right gourd opens: it's Botinho, a pink river dolphin calf! Playful and clever, it's already splashed the floor. River-type creatures have the edge over Ember, Earth and Stone.

Olha só como vocês já se entenderam! Cui.en: Look how well you two already get along! Take good care of it: a happy creature fights better and goes further. If it gets hurt, your mom and any Guardian Post will patch it up for free.

Agora, o favor. Aqui está o Ovo Pintado..en: Now, the favor. Here's the Painted Egg. Hold it with both hands!

O ovo é morno e, de vez em quando, dá um.en: The egg is warm and, every so often, gives a little tap from inside.

Leve ao Seu Aroeira, em Vila Caiçara: sa.en: Take it to Seu Aroeira, in Vila Caiçara: leave town to the north and follow Trilha do Ipê to the end. Then come back and tell me what he said. I'll have a present set aside for you!

Ora, ora! Visita da Vila Jacarandá — e t.en: Well, well! A visitor from Vila Jacarandá — bearing an egg! Let me take a closer look, if you don't mind…

Hum. Casca pintadinha, morna, batendo po.en: Hmm. Speckled shell, warm, tapping inside… Kid, in sixty years of keeping an aviary I've only seen two like this. They come from beach nests, buried in the sand. This one has a story, and I'll hatch it with all the care in the world.

{JOGADOR} entregou o Ovo Pintado ao Seu.en: {JOGADOR} handed the Painted Egg to Seu Aroeira.

Diga à Ipê que o ovo ficou em boas mãos.en: Tell Ipê the egg is in good hands and that I'll call on Rádio Cipó when it hatches. And take this for the trip back. Lemon balm tea: good for creatures and people alike.

Ah! E quando você tiver a insígnia do Me.en: Oh! And once you have Master Gaivota's badge, come by again. I've got an old lesson saved for a trustworthy trainer.

Bem-vindo ao viveiro! Aqui se choca ovo,.en: Welcome to the aviary! Here we hatch eggs, raise little ones and serve coffee. Don't mind the mess: the nest in the living room is mine too.

O Faro só funciona com criatura que conf.en: Scent only works with a creature that trusts you. Walk with it, look after it, and it'll show you what the ground is hiding. Paçoca says hi. Well, she sent a fruit pit. That's her way.

O Ovo Pintado está quietinho perto do fo.en: The Painted Egg is resting quietly by the stove, tapping in rhythm. Head back to the lab and tell Ipê. And drop by once you have the Feather Badge!

Espere aí. Esse seu Tamanduí… é bicho de.en: Hold on. That Tamanduí of yours… it's a leafy critter, isn't it? And you're taking on Master Gaivota with it? The wind on that pier strips leaves like nobody's business. And Gaivota's Tucaninho pecks like a woodpecker.

Tenho aqui um Jabutim que nasceu no vive.en: I've got a Jabutim here that hatched in the aviary and has outgrown the yard. A stone shell doesn't care about pecking. It's slow at everything, even growing up. But once it learns to throw pebbles, no bird will come near.

Cuide bem dele. Jabuti vive mais que a g.en: Take good care of it. Tortoises outlive us: it'll be telling your story to your grandkids one day.

Ah, olha quem voltou do passeio! {JOGADO.en: Oh, look who's back from the trip! {JOGADOR}, the egg courier.

{JOGADOR}, você conhece a Tainá, da casa.en: {JOGADOR}, you know Tainá, from the house across the street. She's heading out into the world too — and she just picked her partner.

Escolhi a que ganha da sua, é claro. Eu.en: I picked the one that beats yours, obviously. I asked which one you took BEFORE choosing. Strategy, sweetie. Professor, can I test it? Just real quick. I promise not to break anything. In the lab.

Uma batalha de estreia? Só se for agora!.en: A debut battle? Right now! But keep away from my samples!

Ganhei! Eu disse que a minha já nasceu g.en: I won! I told you mine was born a winner. Don't sulk, {JOGADOR}: losing to me is practically a compliment.

Tá bom, tá bom. Hoje foi só o começo. Ma.en: Fine, fine. Today was just the beginning. But I'll win all sixteen badges before you even learn the way to Vila Caiçara! I'm off! Don't follow me, I don't like an audience.

Essa menina vai longe. Tomara que na dir.en: That girl will go far. Hopefully in the right direction. But tell me: did Seu Aroeira take the egg? Oh, what a relief! A promise is a promise: here are your presents.

É o Diário de Campo. Ele anota sozinho c.en: It's the Field Journal. It records every creature you meet on its own and completes the entry for those you catch. There are 180 species in Pingorama. I've recorded twelve. I'm counting on you for the other hundred and sixty-eight!

E estas são Cuias de Captura. Criatura s.en: And these are Capture Gourds. A tired wild creature is more open to the invitation: weaken it first, throw second. A gourd welcomes, it doesn't trap. Whoever goes in becomes a partner; and a released partner goes home whenever it likes.

A Mateira Jurema está no começo da Trilh.en: Ranger Jurema is at the start of Trilha do Ipê. Ask her to show you how to catch — she loves an audience. And look for the Vila Caiçara gym: whoever collects the Guardians' sixteen badges can challenge the Council, up on Pico Pingorama. Safe travels, {JOGADOR}!

Ei, {JOGADOR}! Aqui! Cuia nova no cinto,.en: Hey, {JOGADOR}! Over here! New gourd on your belt, huh? I can tell from a mile away, you're walking all lopsided.

Grama alta é casa de criatura selvagem..en: Tall grass is home to wild creatures. Step in and one could show up at any moment. No gourds, no catching. When Prof. Ipê gives you some, come back and I'll teach you the trick.

Capturar é fácil de explicar e difícil d.en: Catching is easy to explain and hard to do well. Listen: One: find the creature in tall grass. Two: battle until its HP bar turns yellow or red, without knocking it out. Three: open the BAG, pick the Gourd and throw it.

A cuia balança uma, duas, três vezes. Se.en: The gourd wobbles once, twice, three times. If it snaps shut, that's it: a new partner in the Field Journal. Sleeping or paralyzed creatures go in more easily. And at night, critters show up that never come out by day.

Chega de conversa. Olha aquela moita mex.en: Enough talk. Look at that bush rustling… It's a Cotiazinha! Go on, it's all yours. Weaken it and throw!

Viu só? Com o tempo a mão acostuma. Toma.en: See? Your hand gets used to it in time. Here, two more gourds, on the house for the lesson.

Vila Caiçara tem Venda: lá a cuia custa.en: Vila Caiçara has a Shop: gourds are cheap there and Dona Cotinha's advice is free. Happy hunting — I mean, happy inviting!

Lembrete da Jurema: enfraquecer, depois.en: A reminder from Jurema: weaken, then throw. And never throw a gourd at another trainer's creature — it's rude.

O Rádio Cipó está chiando no seu bolso!.en: The Rádio Cipó is crackling in your pocket!

…alô? Alô! {JOGADOR}? Aqui é o Aroeira..en: …hello? Hello! {JOGADOR}? It's Aroeira. I heard about the Feather Badge — congratulations, kid! Come by the aviary when you can. I've got a lesson for you… and a little four-legged problem.

Chegou em boa hora! Lembra do ensinament.en: Perfect timing! Remember the lesson I promised? It's called Scent. A creature that trusts its trainer sniffs out what's hidden: buried fruit, shells in the sand, lost scrolls. Pingorama's ground is a treasure chest.

Quem ia demonstrar era a Paçoca, minha C.en: Paçoca, my Cotiazinha, was going to demonstrate. But the rascal sniffed out ripe cashews and vanished into the Campos de Restinga, east of town. She likes hiding in a closed-in nook of trees, way out at the end of the fields, toward the sunrise and the north.

Traga a Paçoca de volta e o Amuleto do F.en: Bring Paçoca back and the Scent Charm is yours. She doesn't bite. Well, she bites cashews.

Uma Cotiazinha de lenço no pescoço, cerc.en: A Cotiazinha with a scarf around its neck, surrounded by cashew peels. It must be Paçoca! She sniffs your hand, recognizes the smell of the aviary and jumps for joy.

A Paçoca saiu disparada na direção de Vi.en: Paçoca dashed off toward Vila Caiçara. Looks like she knows the way home just fine.

A Paçoca chegou antes de você, de barrig.en: Paçoca got here before you, belly full and without a shred of shame! Thank you so much, {JOGADOR}. A promise kept: hold out your hand.

Com o Amuleto do Faro, a sua criatura av.en: With the Scent Charm, your creature lets you know when something's hidden nearby: a sparkle appears on the ground. Go up and take a look. It only works if it really likes you. So treat it well — friendship isn't sold at the Shop.

Agora siga para o leste, pelos mesmos ca.en: Now head east, through the same fields, to the Mata dos Sabiás. Past it is Bosque Alto, the treetop town. Go with the wind!

Nada da Paçoca ainda? Ela se esconde nos.en: No sign of Paçoca yet? She hides in the Campos de Restinga, east of here: look for a closed-in nook of trees in the northeast corner, near the edge of the forest.

Parado aí, {JOGADOR}! Eu vi você saindo.en: Hold it right there, {JOGADOR}! I saw you leaving the gym looking like a winner.

Rá! Viu só? Treina mais, {JOGADOR}. Mas.en: Ha! See? Train harder, {JOGADOR}. But listen, this is serious.

Olha, vou te contar uma coisa, e não é p.en: Look, I'm going to tell you something, and keep it to yourself: I saw some guys in rust-colored overalls on Trilha dos Cipós. They were carrying cages. CAGES, {JOGADOR}. Who puts creatures in cages?

Eles foram para os lados de Porto Sereia.en: They headed toward Porto Sereia. I'm going after them. You… do whatever you want. But take this, I grabbed two by accident.

Não é presente! É… excesso de bagagem. T.en: It's not a gift! It's… extra baggage. Bye!

{JOGADOR}! Então foi VOCÊ que religou a.en: {JOGADOR}! So it was YOU who switched the Old Power Plant back on? I got there and only found crying goons and working outlets. The dock winch is lowering canoes again because of you. Before you set sail, I want my rematch!

Essa foi minha! Anota aí no seu Diário:.en: That one's mine! Write it in your Journal: "Tainá, rare species, undefeated today."

O tal Cartel Ferrugem não é brincadeira,.en: This Rust Cartel is no joke, {JOGADOR}. I heard a goon say the Power Plant's cargo left by boat, toward Ilha do Farol. I'm paddling after it. If you're coming too, don't tailgate my canoe: I like my space.

Isso é para as suas criaturas, não para.en: This is for your creatures, not you. They fought well. You just pushed the buttons. See you in Cidade Coral. Or at the Lighthouse. Or not. Whatever!

Chapéu na cabeça e cocada no tabuleiro:.en: Hat on my head and coconut candy on the tray: life is back to normal. Come by whenever you like, there's always one left for you.

Meu chapéu de palha! Trinta anos comigo.en: My straw hat! Thirty years with me and it never went so far on its own. Here, sweetie: coconut candy with brown sugar, a family recipe. Gives you energy like you wouldn't believe.

Ai, {JOGADOR}, que vento! Levou meu chap.en: Oh, {JOGADOR}, what a wind! It blew my straw hat all the way down by the pier. My legs can't manage that sand anymore. If you find it, I'll make coconut candy just for you.

Um chapéu de palha enganchado no cabeço.en: A straw hat snagged on the mooring post! A bit salty, but in one piece.

Um cabeço de amarração. A corda cheira a.en: A mooring post. The rope smells of sea air and yesterday's fish.

Desenhei a Pintinhas no meu caderno. Con.en: I drew Pintinhas in my notebook. I counted the spots: seven on each side and one extra, on the nose.

É UMA PINTINHAS! De verdade! Ela é mais.en: IT'S A PINTINHAS! A real one! It's prettier than the one on the sticker! Thank you, thank you! Here, my dad makes these gourds with honey. Creatures that go in become friends faster.

Você viaja, né? Então me faz um favor: e.en: You travel, right? Then do me a favor: I REALLY want to see a Pintinhas up close. It's a ladybug of every color. They say it drops from the cashew trees in the Campos de Restinga, but only by day. If you catch one, bring it in your team so I can see?

Fique de frente para a água e use a vara.en: Face the water and use the rod. When the float sinks, pull hard! An Old Rod only brings in small fry. But small fry grow up too. And here's a fisher's tip: in Porto Sereia, canoes only leave the dock pulled by a River-type creature. A Piabinha from the shore will do.

Gosta de pescar? Não? É porque nunca pes.en: Like fishing? No? That's because you've never fished. Here: this rod has been with me my whole life, but my arm gave out before it did.

É a Vara Velha. Fique de frente para qua.en: It's the Old Rod. Face any water, use the rod and wait for a bite. Every water has its fish. And every fish, its story — but that part's on me.

Li a resposta do meu pai umas dez vezes..en: I've read my dad's reply about ten times. He says he's coming back on the next saveiro! Grandma is already making coconut candy for when he arrives. There'll be some for you, don't worry.

Uma resposta do meu pai?! Me dá, me dá!.en: A reply from my dad?! Gimme, gimme! …He wrote that he misses me and brought a present from overseas. You crossed the whole coast for a letter. Keep this: I found it on the beach and never knew how to use it.

Meu pai é o Marinheiro Bartô. Ele vive n.en: My dad is Sailor Bartô. He lives at the Porto Sereia docks, right at the end, looking out to sea. It's far: past Bosque Alto and the Gruta do Eco. No rush — a good letter doesn't go stale.

Um dia eu vou a Porto Sereia visitar meu.en: Someday I'm going to Porto Sereia to visit my dad. He's a sailor! But Grandma won't let me set foot in tall grass without a creature.

Você vai viajar com a sua criatura? Entã.en: You're traveling with your creature? Then you can go where I can't! My dad is Sailor Bartô, from the Porto Sereia docks. I wrote him a letter a month ago and have no way to send it. Will you take it?

Carta? Para mim? Da Vila Jacarandá?! …É.en: A letter? For me? From Vila Jacarandá?! …It's my Dudu's handwriting. Look at the size of that "daddy"! Wait. Hold on — sailors don't cry, it's just sea spray.

Vou responder agora mesmo. Pronto. Leve.en: I'll write back right now. There. Take it back to him, please: tell him I'll be on the next saveiro. And keep this for your trouble. Whoever carries letters deserves to carry good things.

Entregou a resposta ao Dudu? Aquele meni.en: Did you give Dudu the reply? That boy writes better than I sail. Once you have the Paddle, remember: the dock is the gateway to Baía Azul.

Daqui do cais eu vejo a Baía Azul inteir.en: From this dock I can see all of Baía Azul. Far off, when the sky clears, the Lighthouse blinks. I have a son in Vila Jacarandá. It's been a long time since I heard any news from there.

Avisou a minha mãe? Ela mora na primeira.en: Did you tell my mom? She lives in the first house in Bosque Alto, up top, on the left. I'll wait here. I already made friends with a Quatinho. It steals my snacks, but it's friendship.

GENTE! Uma pessoa! Eu entrei na mata atr.en: WOW! A person! I came into the forest after a Saguinho and now every tree looks the same! I'm Nico, from Bosque Alto. I can't get out of here, and if I keep walking I'll get even more lost.

Você avisa a minha mãe? Dona Graúna, a p.en: Will you tell my mom? Dona Graúna, the first house at the top of town. Tell her I'm fine, just… geographically confused.

O Nico está de castigo: uma semana sem e.en: Nico is grounded: a week without his slingshot and map lessons every day. Thanks again, {JOGADOR}. No mom ever forgets a favor like that.

O Nico?! Na Mata dos Sabiás?! Aquele men.en: Nico?! In the Mata dos Sabiás?! That boy gives me a heart attack and then asks for a snack! Dad! DAD! Grab the lantern and the rope, your grandson decided to become an explorer!

Pronto: o avô já trouxe o fujão de volta.en: There: Grandpa brought the runaway back, with a Quatinho hanging off his backpack. Now there are two to bathe. You were an angel. Take this — it's from back when I chased creatures too.

Você viu um menino de estilingue por aí?.en: Have you seen a boy with a slingshot around? Nico left early "to see a little monkey" and still no sign of him. If he's in the Mata dos Sabiás again, I swear I'll tie a bell on him.

Firme como promessa de mãe! Pode atraves.en: Solid as a mother's promise! Cross without fear. The treehouse has a patch of good soil. Whatever you plant there grows singing.

Isso aí no seu cinto é Corda de Cipó? Tr.en: Is that Vine Rope on your belt? Three coils?! Kid, you fell from the sky — and without needing a bridge!

Entregar 3 Cordas de Cipó ao Mestre Imbu.en: Give 3 Vine Ropes to Master Imbuia?

Segura a ponta ali. Não, a outra. A OUTR.en: Hold that end there. No, the other one. The OTHER one. Never mind, I'll do it.

Pronto! Ponte nova, nó de marinheiro e t.en: Done! New bridge, sailor's knots and hardwood planks. The treehouse is yours to visit whenever you like. There's good stuff up there nobody's fetched since the bridge fell.

Tudo bem, corda boa a gente não larga fá.en: That's fine, nobody lets go of good rope easily. But if you change your mind, the bridge will thank you.

Está vendo essa ponte? Pois é. Nem eu. A.en: See that bridge? Exactly. Neither do I. It snapped in the last rain and there went the way to the treehouse. I've got planks. What I need is rope: three coils of Vine Rope, good ones. The Branch Shop sells them, but all my money went on nails.

O Eco está dormindo de cabeça para baixo.en: Eco is sleeping upside down in my helmet. Won't budge for anything. The upper gallery, behind the cracked rock, I'll map someday. When someone breaks the rock.

ECO! Seu fujão de asa! …Ele voltou sozin.en: ECO! You winged runaway! …He came back on his own and just stared at me like he'd been found. It was you, wasn't it? Here: I copied this scroll from an inscription in the cave. It teaches creatures to fly in a flock.

Psiu… você viu um Morceguim com uma fiti.en: Psst… have you seen a Morceguim with a little blue ribbon on its leg? That's Eco, my mapping assistant. A rockfall scared him and he flew deep into the cave, past the river. I can't leave my instruments here.

Se você atravessar a segunda ponte ou co.en: If you cross the second bridge or go around the lake, you should find the back chamber. He likes dark dead-end corners.

Um Morceguim de fitinha azul na pata, en.en: A Morceguim with a little blue ribbon on its leg, huddled in the corner. It's Eco! You slowly hold out your hand. He sniffs, blinks… and takes off toward the bridge.

A Vara Boa alcança o fundo, onde mora o.en: The Good Rod reaches the bottom, where the big fish live. Try it at the docks and in Riacho da Piaba. And if you catch something weird, bring it to me. I don't buy: I admire.

Um Mandizinho! Olha o bigode! Olha o BIG.en: A Mandizinho! Look at those whiskers! Look at those WHISKERS! Thirty years at the market and I'd only seen one in pictures. No, no, I don't want to buy it — that's a partner, not merchandise. I just wanted to see. A promise is a promise: the rod is yours.

Freguês, você tem cara de quem anda por.en: Friend, you look like someone who explores caves. Ever seen a Mandizinho? A whiskered catfish that lives in the dark, in the waters of the Gruta do Eco. If you ever have one in your team, bring it to meet me. I'll give you a Good Rod, made of master bamboo, in return.

Esse aí ainda é ovo. Ovo eu registro qua.en: That one's still an egg. I register eggs once they hatch — I'm no fortune teller.

um lugar que nem o caderno sabe.en: a place not even the notebook knows

Cresceu que foi uma beleza! Isso é comid.en: It's grown like a weed! That's good food and honest battling.

Já engordou uns níveis. Está no caminho..en: It's already put on a few levels. On the right track.

Ainda está com cheirinho de capim novo..en: It still smells like fresh grass.

A alavanca já está abaixada. Lá do outro.en: The lever is already down. Across the hall, the gate is still open.

Uma alavanca de ferro, lubrificada com c.en: An iron lever, lovingly greased. The little plate says: "EAST STAIRWAY GATE".

CLANC! Do outro lado do salão, uma grade.en: CLANK! Across the hall, a heavy gate creaks its way up.

A chave geral está ligada. O painel zumb.en: The main switch is on. The panel hums quietly, content.

CHAVE GERAL DA USINA. Alguém colou um av.en: POWER PLANT MAIN SWITCH. Someone stuck a Cartel notice over it: "DO NOT TURN ON. LIEUTENANT'S ORDERS." The notice is held on with chewing gum.

As lâmpadas do porão acendem uma a uma.\.en: The basement lights come on one by one. Upstairs, the control room's electric door goes "click".

A jaula está vazia e de porta aberta. Fi.en: The cage is empty, its door wide open. All that's left is a wisp of grass and a smell of thunderstorm.

Uma jaula do Cartel Ferrugem. Lá dentro,.en: A Rust Cartel cage. Inside, a Vagalumim blinks weakly, in distress code. The padlock is electric: it only opens from the control room.

Quem ligou a chave geral?! Eu mandei col.en: Who turned on the main switch?! I had a notice put up! With the good chewing gum!

Ah, é só uma criança enxerida. Escute aq.en: Oh, it's just a nosy kid. Listen here: this power plant is now a Rust Cartel "living battery" factory. Every Thunder creature is worth a fortune on the market. And you're not going to ruin my monthly quota!

Amassada por uma criança… O Coronel Garr.en: Crushed by a kid… Colonel Garrote is going to send me to the scrapyard.

Fique com a sua usina! A carga boa já sa.en: Keep your power plant! The good cargo already left by boat anyway. Rebite is handling the rest, at the lighthouse. Oops. I didn't say lighthouse. I said… light… house. It's something else.

A tenente Lata e os capangas fugiram pel.en: Lieutenant Lata and her goons ran off across the catwalk. The Old Power Plant's generators start spinning again. The basement cages open on their own!

Você religou a Usina! Eu estava trancada.en: You got the Power Plant running again! I'd been locked in the storeroom for three days, living on cassava biscuits. With the power back on, the crane at the Porto Sereia dock can lower the canoes. Baía Azul is open to anyone with the Paddle!

A estação também acendeu, mas o maquinis.en: The station lit up too, but the engineer only lets League of Guardians Champions on board. Mountain line rules. Here, this is from the director's drawer. He won't miss it.

O Saveiro sobe o rio até Porto Pantaneir.en: The Saveiro sails up the river to Porto Pantaneiro, in the Sertão das Névoas.

Mas o mestre só leva quem venceu a Liga.en: But the skipper only takes those who've beaten the League of Guardians. Says the Sertão is no Sunday stroll.

Subia, quer dizer. O barco está no estal.en: Used to sail, I mean. The boat's in the shipyard, hull up, and the skipper swears it'll be back in the water soon. And even after the repairs he only takes those who've beaten the League of Guardians. Says the Sertão is no Sunday stroll.

Campeão a bordo! Bilhete conferido. O Sa.en: A Champion aboard! Ticket checked. The Saveiro is at the end of the dock: just walk up the gangplank. Next stop: Porto Pantaneiro, Sertão das Névoas. Seasickness is the passenger's problem.

Campeão da Liga no meu cais! Bilhete con.en: A League Champion on my dock! Ticket checked, all good… except the boat. The Saveiro is in the shipyard for repairs: new planks, new sail. Hang on to that ticket: it's good as soon as the hull's back in the water. Soon, says the skipper. Rádio Cipó will let you know.

Campeão da Liga e sem bilhete? O Cacique.en: A League Champion with no ticket? Chief Aracê hands one to every Champion, up on the Platô. Take a look in your bag.

Cais do Saveiro, linha Cidade Coral ⇄ Po.en: Saveiro Dock, Cidade Coral - Porto Pantaneiro line. Pretty, huh? Well, it's just for looking. The skipper only goes up the river with a League of Guardians Champion aboard, ticket in hand.

A Liga fica no Platô, depois de Vila Bur.en: The League is on the Platô, past Vila Buriti. Eight badges to get in, five battles in a row to come out Champion. You look like someone who'll make it. I look like someone who sells tickets. Everyone has their talent.

A mãe respondeu a carta com três páginas.en: Mom answered the letter with three pages and a cornbread recipe. You're the best mail carrier Gruta Breu has ever seen!

Você entregou?! E ela mandou resposta?!.en: You delivered it?! And she wrote back?! Let me see… "My dear daughter, wear a sweater." That's her, all right.

Promessa é dívida. Este pergaminho era d.en: A promise is a promise. This scroll was my grandfather's. He used to say it teaches a creature to shine like lace in the sun.

A carta é para a Vó Candinha, no sobrado.en: The letter is for Vó Candinha, in the yellow two-story house in Serra Fumaça, on the other side of Gruta Breu. Don't get it wet, don't crumple it and please, don't read it. There's gossip in it.

Ai, moço… moça… treinador! Você vai para.en: Oh, young man… young lady… trainer! Are you headed toward Serra Fumaça? My mother lives there, and the mail stopped once Gruta Breu lost its lights.

Levar a carta da rendeira para Serra Fum.en: Take the lacemaker's letter to Serra Fumaça?

{JOGADOR} guardou a Carta de Renda no bo.en: {JOGADOR} tucked the Lace Letter into the driest pocket of the bag.

É para a Vó Candinha, no sobrado amarelo.en: It's for Vó Candinha, in the yellow house just past the mouth of the cave. Tell her the trousseau lace is almost done. It's been almost done for two years.

Tudo bem. Vou amarrar numa garrafa e jog.en: That's fine. I'll put it in a bottle and toss it in the sea. Should get there in about forty years.

Diga para a minha filha que aqui na serr.en: Tell my daughter that up here in the mountains we sleep in socks. And that I want to see that lace finished before my hundredth birthday.

Carta? Para mim? De Cidade Coral?! Faz t.en: A letter? For me? From Cidade Coral?! The mail carrier hasn't crossed the cave in so long I thought the sea had dried up.

A Vó Candinha lê a carta três vezes, ri.en: Vó Candinha reads the letter three times, laughs twice and grumbles once.

\"A renda do enxoval está quase pronta.\.en: "The trousseau lace is almost done." Ha! That girl takes after her father. Hold on, I'll write back. There. And this is for you, for the postage. A moon stone: found it in the cemetery, but I swear nobody was using it.

{JOGADOR} guardou a Resposta da Vó Candi.en: {JOGADOR} put Vó Candinha's Reply away with the cornbread recipe.

Nesta casa só entra visita com notícia..en: Only visitors with news come into this house. Do you have news? No? Then have a coffee and go find some. My daughter is a lacemaker down in Cidade Coral. If you pass by the square, tell her that her mother is still alive and still cranky.

Soube que você entregou uma carta que ve.en: I heard you delivered a letter that came through Gruta Breu! Now I've got no excuse not to work. At least let me stamp your bag. There: "DELIVERED WITH LOVE".

Sou o carteiro de Serra Fumaça. Na nebli.en: I'm the mail carrier of Serra Fumaça. In the fog I deliver letters by feel: I knock on the door and ask who's there.

De Cidade Coral não chega nada desde que.en: Nothing's come from Cidade Coral since the cave went dark. Vó Candinha, in the yellow house up there, asks about letters every single day.

Eu sou a Dona Bilro, do registro. Toda p.en: I'm Dona Bilro, from the registry. Every partner that passes through this island, I write down: where it came from and how big it was. Let me see yours. With my glasses. Where are my glasses?

Tudo anotado. Pela ficha limpa, tome: é.en: All written down. For the clean record, here: honey from my backyard. A well-registered creature deserves a treat.

Volte quando tiver parceira nova. O cade.en: Come back when you have a new partner. The notebook can take it.

Soube que a Faísca do Volta já está acen.en: I heard Volta's Faísca is lighting up the lighthouse again. Seaweed Syrup: my great-grandmother's recipe — she was a mermaid in her spare time.

O xarope não vai se entregar sozinho, cr.en: That syrup won't deliver itself, friend! Faísca is waiting at the top of the lighthouse.

O Volta mandou pedir Xarope de Algas? Pa.en: Volta sent for Seaweed Syrup? For Faísca? Poor Poraquê, they drained her battery to the bone. If an electric eel even has bones.

Espere… alga-parda, uma pitada de sal gr.en: Hold on… brown seaweed, a pinch of coarse salt, honey to help it go down… Done! Shake before giving. The bottle, not the Poraquê.

{JOGADOR} recebeu o Xarope de Algas! O f.en: {JOGADOR} received the Seaweed Syrup! The bottle is warm and goes "glub".

Sou a Moça Sargaço, boticária. Remédio d.en: I'm Moça Sargaço, the apothecary. Sea remedies are my thing: seaweed syrup, shell ointment, foam tea. If anyone on the bay gets sick, just send for me. Or send someone to fetch the medicine, because I get seasick in canoes.

A alavanca já está puxada. O cabo que de.en: The lever's already pulled. The cable running down to the ground floor is pulled taut.

Uma alavanca com um cabo de aço que some.en: A lever with a steel cable that disappears through the floorboards. A label in Volta's handwriting: "STAIRWAY 2 GATE (don't forget to leave it open!!)".

RRRRÉC! Lá embaixo, uma grade sobe e bat.en: RRRRRK! Down below, a gate shoots up and slams into the ceiling.

{JOGADOR}?! Eu falei para não colar na m.en: {JOGADOR}?! I told you not to tag along in my canoe, and you came by the stairs!

Lá em cima tem um tenente do Cartel com.en: Up there, there's a Cartel lieutenant with the whole bay's Thunder creatures in cages. I was going to handle it myself, but… But nothing. Before you go up, you're going to show me you won't get in the way!

Ganhei. Então fica combinado: eu fui a f.en: I won. So it's settled: I was the favorite and you got lucky I was in a hurry.

Tá bom, tá bom. Você melhorou. Um pouco..en: Fine, fine. You've gotten better. A little. Don't tell anyone I said that.

Escuta: eu já derrubei meia escada de ca.en: Listen: I've already knocked down half a staircase of goons and mine are running on fumes. Yours too, after that. Let me fix that.

Pronto, novas em folha. Remédio da minha.en: There, good as new. My grandma's remedy — don't ask what's in it. You go up. I'll stay here holding the stairs: if a goon comes running down, he'll trip over me.

E {JOGADOR}… solta todas as jaulas, tá?.en: And {JOGADOR}… open every cage, okay? Every single one.

Jaula aberta e vazia. Sobrou uma pena ch.en: Cage open and empty. All that's left is a singed feather and a happy buzz in the air.

Jaulas do Cartel empilhadas até o teto:.en: Cartel cages stacked to the ceiling: Poraquins, Vagalumins and Grilinhos, all wired up to the lighthouse lamp. The Cartel is using the creatures as batteries!

A Faísca nada em oito dentro do aquário..en: Faísca swims figure eights in the tank. With every lap, the lighthouse lamp shines brighter.

O aquário da lanterna. A Faísca, a Poraq.en: The lamp's tank. Faísca, Volta's Poraquê, is lying on the bottom, dark as a burnt-out bulb.

Um aquário enorme, cheio de fios do Cart.en: A huge tank full of Cartel wires. At the bottom, a Poraquê with barely any glow.

Parado aí. Mais um passo e você pisa no.en: Stop right there. One more step and you'll be on my clean floor.

Tenente Rebite, Cartel Ferrugem. Este fa.en: Lieutenant Rebite, Rust Cartel. This lighthouse is now an antenna: with these creatures' power, Colonel Garrote will speak to the whole coast. And the whole coast will obey.

O faroleiro discorda. O faroleiro está a.en: The lighthouse keeper disagrees. The lighthouse keeper is tied up. Goons: screw down our guest!

Incompetentes. Tudo eu, tudo eu.\fArrume.en: Incompetents. I have to do everything myself. Patch up your creatures, if you like: I prefer to tighten bolts that are in one piece. When you get close, I'll tighten you personally.

Pronto? Venha, então. Eu aperto você pes.en: Ready? Come on, then. I'll tighten you personally.

Soltou… Tudo o que eu prendo, solta. A L.en: Loose… Everything I tighten comes loose. Lata was right: this coast is bad luck.

Fique com o seu farol. O Coronel tem pla.en: Keep your lighthouse. The Colonel has bigger plans in the Sertão, and there are no kids with canoes there. Rust Cartel: fall back!

O tenente Rebite e os capangas descem a.en: Lieutenant Rebite and his goons stumble down the stairs. One by one, the cages open. The Thunder creatures fly out the lamp room window, blinking with relief.

Ufa! Obrigado, obrigado! Três dias amarr.en: Phew! Thank you, thank you! Three days tied up, and the worst part: I couldn't tinker with anything! I'm Volta: lighthouse keeper, inventor and, in my spare time, the island's Gym Leader.

Você merece mais que um aperto de mão. T.en: You deserve more than a handshake. Take my Lantern: I made it myself. With an Ember, Thunder or Charm partner on your team, it chases away any darkness. Even the one in Gruta Breu!

Agora, o ginásio… Eu adoraria um desafio.en: Now, the gym… I'd love a challenge, but look at Faísca, my Poraquê. She's the one who lights the lighthouse lamp, and those brutes drained her battery. I'm not leaving here without Faísca. And a worried Leader battles badly.

Só o Xarope de Algas da Moça Sargaço, a.en: Only Moça Sargaço's Seaweed Syrup can perk up an electric fish — she's the apothecary in Cidade Coral. Would you paddle there for me? Bring the syrup and I'll open the gym right away. Inventor's word: it almost never fails!

O Faroleiro Volta está amarrado com fio.en: Lighthouse Keeper Volta is tied up with telephone wire. He points his chin at the lieutenant.

É o Xarope de Algas?! Dá aqui! Sacudiu?.en: Is that the Seaweed Syrup?! Hand it over! Did you shake it? Sargaço always says to shake it.

O Volta pinga o xarope no aquário. A águ.en: Volta drips the syrup into the tank. The water turns green, then blue, then… sparks!

A Faísca dá um salto e a lanterna do far.en: Faísca leaps up and the lighthouse lamp blazes to life all at once. The beam sweeps across all of Baía Azul!

Ela voltou! Olha esse brilho! Dá para le.en: She's back! Look at that glow! You could read a newspaper in Porto Sereia with this light!

Promessa de inventor se cumpre: o ginási.en: An inventor keeps his promises: the gym is open. I'll head down first to switch on the circuits. Wear rubber soles!

E leve mais um invento meu: o Chocalho d.en: And take one more of my inventions: the Teamwork Rattle. It shares what a creature learns in battle with the ones left behind. Anyone in reserve, two or more levels below your strongest, gets half the experience just by listening. From here to the mountains the trainers get tougher: nobody climbs that with just one creature.

A Faísca continua apagadinha… O Xarope d.en: Faísca is still dim… The Seaweed Syrup comes from Moça Sargaço, the apothecary in Cidade Coral. She's near the Shop. Paddle west, then south. I'll stay here singing to Faísca. She pretends to like it.

O farol acendeu e o mestre voltou para o.en: The lighthouse is lit and the master is back at the gym! The workshop is a mess, so everything's normal. Faísca sent a little thank-you zap. I'll pass it on: bzzt.

O mestre não desce do farol enquanto a F.en: The master won't come down from the lighthouse until Faísca gets better. Poraquês are like that: no battery, no spark. The cure is the Seaweed Syrup from the apothecary in Cidade Coral. She's on the street with the Shop.

Sou a Centelha, aprendiz do Volta. Ele s.en: I'm Centelha, Volta's apprentice. He went up the lighthouse three days ago "to take a quick look" and never came back. Then some people in rust-colored overalls went up. I locked the workshop and I'm pretending nobody's here. You didn't see me.

Rádio Farol no ar! Hoje: previsão da mar.en: Rádio Farol, on the air! Today: the tide forecast, guitar ballads and our segment "Who's Seen the Giant Turtle?". They say she surfaces to breathe at the Sunken Reef every Friday. Only on Fridays.

Eu sou o Zé Dial, radioamador. O meu tra.en: I'm Zé Dial, ham radio operator. My transmitter died the day the lighthouse went out: it burned the dynamo's gear.

Dar uma Engrenagem Velha para o Zé Dial?.en: Give an Old Gear to Zé Dial?

Serve certinho! Escuta só: chhh… \"Rádio.en: Fits perfectly! Listen: shhh… "Rádio Farol calling Baía Azul"… IT WORKS! You just saved the only guitar ballad show on the coast. Here, it's from the listeners' prize chest.

Sem engrenagem, sem rádio. Sem rádio, a.en: No gear, no radio. No radio, and the island doesn't even know what time the tide is.

Se achar uma Engrenagem Velha por aí, me.en: If you find an Old Gear somewhere, bring it to me. In Vila Ferrugem they say they're lying all over the ground, but that's a long way off.

Então o galho do portão era um Urutauzim.en: So the branch at the gate was an Urutauzim pretending to be a stick? Twenty years of gardening and I've been watering a bird. Keep the Watering Can. A watered garden bed bears fruit faster.

Sou a jardineira do cemitério. Tem um ga.en: I'm the cemetery gardener. There's a dry branch stuck right in the gate that I didn't plant, don't prune and can't pull out. And the weird part: every time I water it, it moves.

Você tem um Regador? Então regue você. E.en: You've got a Watering Can? Then you water it. I'm not going near it again.

Tome o meu Regador reserva. Se o galho m.en: Take my spare Watering Can. If the branch bites, that's the branch's fault.

Um galho seco, fincado bem no meio do po.en: A dry branch, stuck right in the middle of the cemetery gate. There are two knots in the wood that look like closed eyes.

O galho arregala os olhos e abre um bico.en: The branch's eyes pop open and it opens a beak the size of a drawer!

Ele não sai do lugar por nada. Talvez co.en: It won't budge for anything. Maybe with a little water…

Com as suas engrenagens eu terminei o me.en: With your gears I finished my hand-cranked sundial. It works even at night. Don't ask me how.

Eu sou o Seu Ferro-Velho. Coleciono Engr.en: I'm Seu Ferro-Velho. I collect Old Gears from the old factory: each one reminds me of a shift buddy. Bring me three and I'll give you something that really shines.

Uma do torno, uma da prensa, uma da este.en: One from the lathe, one from the press, one from conveyor belt three… You brought the whole crew back! A deal's a deal: a Gold Gourd, forged right here. And a block of rapadura, since nobody's made of iron.

Ainda não tem três? Procure na Encosta d.en: Don't have three yet? Look on Encosta da Fumaça, near the boulder at the east exit, and at the back of my yard — I lost one there myself.

E o ovo, já nasceu? Ande bastante com el.en: So, has the egg hatched? Walk around a lot with it: eggs love the swaying of a backpack. The Tartaruí Project thanks you. Come back at night to see the mothers climb up the sand.

Bem-vindo ao Projeto Tartaruí! Eu sou a.en: Welcome to the Tartaruí Project! I'm Dr. Maré, the coordinator. You came with the Star badge, so you know how to tread lightly.

Preciso de alguém de confiança. Achamos.en: I need someone I can trust. We found an egg in a turtle nest, but it's not a turtle's: it's warm, spotted differently and came with a tag from Prof. Ipê Amarelo's lab. Some Cartel smuggler must have dropped it while fleeing.

A Profª Ipê disse pelo rádio que é irmão.en: Prof. Ipê said over the radio that it's a sibling of the creature she entrusted to you, and that there are no better hands than yours. Will you look after it?

Ficar com o ovo do ninho?.en: Take the egg from the nest?

Ele vai nascer depois de uma boa caminha.en: It'll hatch after a good long walk. Or paddle: a rocking canoe counts too, I think. Science is still debating it.

Sem pressa. Ele fica aquecido na areia a.en: No rush. It'll stay warm in the sand until you come back.

Um ninho na areia. No escuro, dá para ou.en: A nest in the sand. In the dark, you can hear the eggs quietly cracking. A newborn Tartaruí pokes its head out, looks at the moon and runs for the sea.

Um ninho de tartaruga cercado por estaca.en: A turtle nest surrounded by stakes and Tartaruí Project tape. A little sign: "Clutch no. 37. Don't step here. The mothers come up the beach at night."

Estação fria! Chegaram os visitantes do.en: Cold season! The visitors from the south have arrived: there are lost Pinguinzinhos in the grass at the point and a whale with her calf out in the bay. We don't force a penguin to go back. It leaves when it warms up. Or stays, if it likes you.

No calor só tem tartaruga, siri e turist.en: When it's hot there are only turtles, crabs and tourists. In the cold season, from June to September, that's when the penguins and whales arrive. Come back when it cools off. Bring a coat: for you, not the penguin.

A água do recife está diferente hoje. Um.en: The reef water is different today. A wide, slow shadow passes near the sandy clearing…

A Tartaruga-Gigante das sextas-feiras! O.en: The Friday Giant Turtle! Her shell is a walking reef: it has coral, barnacles and a little fish tenant. She looks at you slowly. Very slowly.

A gruta do fundo está vazia. Na areia fi.en: The cave at the back is empty. In the sand there's the trail of a long body, as long as a river.

No fundo da gruta, dois faróis verdes se.en: At the back of the cave, two green beacons light up. They're not beacons. All the water in the reef starts swirling slowly around you.

A BOIÚNA, a cobra-grande das águas, dese.en: The BOIÚNA, the great serpent of the waters, uncoils its body and raises its head!

A Boiúna afunda no redemoinho e a água d.en: The Boiúna sinks into the whirlpool and the reef water stops swirling. The great serpent was never seen again.

Algo imenso dorme enrolado no fundo da g.en: Something immense sleeps coiled at the back of the cave. Each breath it takes pushes you back a hand's width. Noise won't wake it, and neither will light. It seems to be waiting for a rhythm… a berimbau beat you don't know yet.

Quinze insígnias, contei uma por uma. O.en: Fifteen badges, I counted them one by one. The mountain recognizes you. Climb with respect: cliff face, darkness and waterfall, in that order. Up at the top, Shaman Trovão-Velho has been waiting a long time for someone like you.

Alto. Eu sou Abaeté, guardião do Monte T.en: Halt. I am Abaeté, guardian of Monte Tupã. This trail leads to the Aldeia and to the last gym in Pingorama.

O monte só se abre para quem carrega qui.en: The mountain only opens for those who carry fifteen badges. Let me count yours… one… two… That's not fifteen. Come back when the whole Sertão das Névoas knows your name.

A Escama está com você. O céu sobre a Al.en: The Scale is yours. The sky over the Aldeia has changed: listen. On the highest rock, to the north, Gavião-Tupã has landed to get a close look at the one the thunder chose.

Bem-vindo à Aldeia Tupã, o lugar mais pe.en: Welcome to Aldeia Tupã, the place closest to the sky in all of Pingorama. Shaman Trovão-Velho guards the Scale badge. The gym's four trials ask for everything you learned on both maps: forest, fire, water and wind.

A pedra mais alta do Monte Tupã. Ficou u.en: The highest rock on Monte Tupã. A long feather was left behind; it crackles when you touch it.

O ar fica parado. Os pelos do braço se a.en: The air goes still. The hair on your arms stands up. Far away, thunder with no cloud.

O GAVIÃO-TUPÃ desce do céu e pousa na pe.en: GAVIÃO-TUPÃ swoops down from the sky and lands on the rock! Every beat of its wings is a lightning bolt.

O Gavião-Tupã cai, se ergue num estalo d.en: Gavião-Tupã falls, rises in a crack of thunder and vanishes above the clouds. It was never seen on Monte Tupã again.

A pedra mais alta do Monte Tupã. Está ri.en: The highest rock on Monte Tupã. It's scored by lightning from top to bottom. The sky here seems to be waiting for someone. It's not you yet: you still need the Shaman's badge.

A Insígnia Pena fica bem em você.\fJá fa.en: The Feather Badge looks good on you. Have you talked to Seu Aroeira yet? And don't forget: Bosque Alto is past Mata dos Sabiás. To get down, just hop into the gust after the second mast: the sea will drop you back at the entrance.

Chegou até aqui sem cair no mar? Então j.en: Made it this far without falling in the sea? Then you've already learned half the lesson: you don't pick fights with the wind. I'll teach you the other half right now. I am Master Gaivota!

Rapaz… você voou mais alto que as minhas.en: Well, I'll be… you flew higher than my kites. Here: the Feather Badge is yours!

Esse pergaminho ensina o Rasante: um voo.en: This scroll teaches Low Swoop: a low, precise dive that hardly ever misses. Now listen. Seu Aroeira, here in the village, is looking for someone trustworthy for a job. They say he keeps a Charm that lets creatures sniff out hidden things. After that, head through Campos de Restinga and cross Mata dos Sabiás. In Bosque Alto, Lia Teia awaits challengers high up in the treetops. Oh, and there's no plank to get down from the pier: let the right-hand current carry you and jump into the gust after the second mast. The sea returns everyone to the entrance!

O Facão abre os cipós da Rota 3. Siga po.en: The Machete clears the vines on Route 3. Follow it and go through Gruta do Eco to Porto Sereia. And come back whenever you like: up here there's always a new bug to meet.

Você atravessou as sete… quer dizer, as.en: You crossed all seven… I mean, all six bridges in the right order. People in a hurry never make it here. I'm Lia Teia, canopy biologist. Now let's see that patience in battle!

Incrível! Nem a minha Pintinhas consegui.en: Amazing! Not even my Pintinhas could tangle you up. The Cocoon Badge is yours!

Leve também o Amuleto do Facão. Com uma.en: Take the Machete Charm too. With a Grass, Bug or Brawl creature on your team, thick vines stop being walls.

Esse pergaminho ensina o Enxame: uma nuv.en: This scroll teaches Swarm: a cloud of wings that gives the opponent no peace. The vines blocking Route 3, east of the forest, are now a solved problem. After it comes Gruta do Eco and, on the other side, Porto Sereia. Sailor Netuno Silva runs the gym there, and he loves getting challengers soaked.

A Rota 4 sai pelo leste da cidade e term.en: Route 4 leaves from the east side of the city and ends at the Old Power Plant. Until that's sorted out, the south dock has no power and nobody sets sail for Baía Azul. Go see what's going on, sailor. After that, with the Paddle, just head down the dock to Cidade Coral.

Abriu as minhas eclusas na ordem certa!.en: You opened my locks in the right order! You've got a river pilot's head. I'm Netuno Silva, captain of this gym. Now let's see if your arm keeps up with your head!

Naufraguei no meu próprio cais! Você mer.en: Shipwrecked on my own dock! You've earned it: the Shell Badge is yours!

E leve o Amuleto do Remo. Com uma criatu.en: And take the Paddle Charm. With a River-type creature on your team, it'll pull your canoe across any calm water. Don't have one? No need to go back: with the Old Rod, Piabinhas bite right off the edge of the dock. And Seu Arraia, down on the beach, will trade his Mandizinho for a Pipirim. Without a River creature, nobody crosses Baía Azul.

Esse pergaminho ensina a Enxurrada: uma.en: This scroll teaches Flash Flood: a wall of water that sweeps away whatever's in front of it. Now pay attention. For days, strange smoke has been coming out of the Old Power Plant, at the end of Route 4, east of here. Since then the south dock has had no power and the train station's been dark. They say it's the work of some Cartel. Sort it out and the dock will work again: with the Paddle you can go down Baía Azul to Cidade Coral, where the lacemaker Iracema Lua keeps the Charm gym.

A Ilha do Farol fica ao norte da cidade..en: Ilha do Farol is north of the city. The lighthouse has gone dark and Lighthouse Keeper Volta vanished inside: go see what happened. And stop by Praia das Tartarugas when you can. They say there's a new nest there.

Acendeu as minhas duas estrelas! Pouca g.en: You lit both my stars! Few people understand that light needs a path, just like thread on a lace pillow. I'm Iracema Lua, lacemaker of Cidade Coral. Let's see if your team shines too!

Que coisa mais linda de se ver! Tome, me.en: What a lovely thing to see! Here, dear: the Star Badge is yours!

Esse pergaminho ensina o Clarão da Lua:.en: This scroll teaches Moonflash: a light so bright even Legend creatures feel it. Now listen, dear. For nights the Ilha do Farol lighthouse hasn't lit, and the sailboats are hitting the reefs. Lighthouse Keeper Volta, who's also the Leader there, hasn't been seen since. They say some fellows in gray uniforms took over the tower. The island is north of here. If you sort it out, Volta will want to meet you… and his gym is Thunder type.

Deixei todas as pontes ligadas para você.en: I left all the bridges on so you can wander around. Gruta Breu starts from Cidade Coral: with your Lantern lit you can cross to Serra Fumaça. Dona Benta Sombra, over there, tells hair-raising tales.

Então foi você que tirou aquele bando do.en: So you're the one who ran that gang out of my lighthouse! And you switched on my bridges in the right order too. I ought to thank you… but an inventor says thanks with an experiment. Let's test your resistance!

Experiência concluída: você conduz melho.en: Experiment complete: you conduct better than copper wire! The Bolt Badge is yours!

Esse pergaminho ensina o Choque de Poraq.en: This scroll teaches Eel Shock: a discharge that leaves the opponent paralyzed. Now write this down. With the Lantern you got at the lighthouse you can cross Gruta Breu, which starts from Cidade Coral. On the other side is Serra Fumaça. The gym there belongs to Dona Benta Sombra, the storyteller. Her type is Spook, and the place is darker than a ship's hold. Bring a creature that can light the Lantern!

Deixei os lustres acesos para você: agor.en: I left the chandeliers lit for you: now all the trapdoors are in plain sight. The cracked rocks on Route 5 won't stop anyone with Rock Smash anymore. At the end of it is Vila Ferrugem.

Ora, ora… atravessou o meu sobrado e ain.en: Well, well… you crossed my old manor and still arrived with your flame lit. It's been a long time since a tale started off so well. I'm Benta Sombra. Now let me tell the part where the ghosts show up!

Credo em cruz! Você espantou até as minh.en: Heavens above! You scared off even my apparitions. The Lamp Badge is yours!

Leve também o Amuleto Quebra-pedra. Com.en: Take the Rock Smash Charm too. With a Stone, Earth, Iron or Brawl creature on your team, cracked rocks turn to gravel.

Esse pergaminho ensina a Bola de Breu: u.en: This scroll teaches Pitch Ball: a handful of darkness hurled right at the opponent. Now hear the next chapter. Route 5 goes down the mountain, but it's clogged with cracked rocks: Rock Smash takes care of that. At the end of it is Vila Ferrugem, where Engineer Bigorna runs an Iron gym full of conveyor belts and gears. They say the floor there moves by itself… that's a tale I want to hear from you.

Desliguei as esteiras para você circular.en: I turned off the conveyor belts so you can move around freely. The boulders at the town's east exit won't stop anyone with Strength anymore. Estrada do Buriti leads to Vila Buriti, the last badge of the Costa do Sol.

Dois circuitos, quatro engrenagens, uma.en: Two circuits, four gears, a press… and here you are, without a scratch. I like it. I'm Engineer Bigorna. On to the load test: your team against mine!

Teste concluído: resistência acima da no.en: Test complete: resistance above spec. The Gear Badge is yours!

Leve o Amuleto da Força. Com uma criatur.en: Take the Strength Charm. With an Earth, Stone or Brawl creature on your team, boulders become wheelbarrows.

Esse pergaminho ensina a Bigornada: o pe.en: This scroll teaches Anvil Drop: the weight of a whole workshop in a single blow. Now, the route. The town's east exit is blocked by boulders: with Strength you push through to Estrada do Buriti. At the end of it is Vila Buriti, where the herbalist Dona Buriti keeps the eighth badge. And after that… well, they say there's a plateau that only those with all eight can enter.

Os cipós sossegaram desde a sua vitória:.en: The vines have calmed down since your win: you can wander the greenhouse as you please. The trail out of town climbs to the Platô da Liga. With all eight badges, the Entrance Guardian will open the gate for you.

Ora, ora! Passou pelos meus cipós sem le.en: Well, well! Got past my vines without getting whipped? Then you've got patience and hurry in just the right amounts. I'm Dona Buriti, this town's herbalist and the last Leader of the Costa do Sol. Let's see what your team has at the root!

Arre! Nem chá de boldo cura uma derrota.en: Goodness! Not even boldo tea cures a loss like that. Here, the Leaf Badge is yours!

Esse pergaminho ensina o Abraço de Sumaú.en: This scroll teaches Kapok Hug: the tree squeezes and even gives strength back to its user. Now listen to this old woman: that's eight badges on your chest. The trail out of town climbs to the Platô da Liga, and the Entrance Guardian only opens the gate for those who have all eight. Up there are four Masters and the Champion, one after the other, with no rest. Whoever beats the League earns passage to the Sertão das Névoas. Pack medicine in your bag and go with this herbalist's blessing.

Ginga apanha de Vento, de Mente e de Enc.en: Brawl gets beaten by Wind, Mind and Charm. Remember that for the fourth room of the Platô.

Aprendi o ofício com o Brasa-Viva em pes.en: I learned the trade from Brasa-Viva himself. My team is made of iron. What's yours made of?

Ferro não sente Veneno e ri de golpe Com.en: Iron shrugs off Poison and laughs at Normal moves. But it melts with Ember and sinks with Earth.

Trabalho com a Drª Buriti. Ela mandou te.en: I work with Dr. Buriti. She told me to test every trainer who comes up the road. Science!

A doutora guarda uma criatura especial p.en: The doctor keeps a special creature for whoever beats the town's gym. Don't say I told you.

Quem chega em Vila Buriti / com sete ins.en: Who reaches Vila Buriti / with seven badges on their chest / must beat this singer here / or go home and take a rest!

Calou-se a viola / diante da sua escola..en: My guitar's gone still / before your mighty skill.

Depois da vila é o Platô: quatro Mestres.en: After the town comes the Platô: four Masters, one Champion and no healing on the way. Fill up your bag.

Então a professora te deu uma criatura t.en: So the professor gave you a creature too? Great. Mine was born beating you!

Quê?! Isso foi… foi o sol no meu olho! D.en: What?! That was… that was the sun in my eyes! Next time, no excuses. Not for you either!

Insígnia do Casulo? Eu peguei a minha on.en: The Cocoon Badge? I got mine yesterday, with my eyes closed. Come on, {JOGADOR}: I'll show you what a real team looks like!

De novo?! Tá, tá bom. Você treina… direi.en: Again?! Fine, fine. You train… decently. But I train MORE, got it?

Remo no cinto e luz no cais, é? Antes de.en: Paddle on your belt and light on the dock, huh? Before you see the open sea, {JOGADOR}, you'll be seeing stars. My team evolved — and so did I!

Hunf. Perdi limpo, eu sei. …Aqueles capa.en: Hmph. I lost fair and square, I know. …Those goons at the Power Plant were cowards to the creatures. You did the right thing. Don't tell anyone I said that.

Alerta de escoteira: a luz da cidade pis.en: Scout alert: the city lights are flickering and I'M going to find out why! Right after I beat you.

A Usina Velha fica no fim da estrada. Te.en: The Old Power Plant is at the end of the road. There's an iron gate and some shady folks out front.

Psiu! Os Urubuzins estão rodando em cima.en: Shh! The Urubuzins are circling over the Power Plant. Bad sign. Good sign for a battle!

Voaram todos. Inclusive a minha dignidad.en: They all flew off. Including my dignity.

Urubuzim só vira Urubu-Rei no nível 36..en: Urubuzim only becomes Urubu-Rei at level 36. Patience is the watcher's wing.

Minha pipa enroscou no fio da Usina e de.en: My kite got tangled in the Power Plant's wires and zapped my cricket. He liked it!

Agora quem levou choque fui eu..en: Now I'm the one who got zapped.

Criatura de Trovão adora a Usina. De noi.en: Thunder creatures love the Power Plant. At night the grass by the road buzzes with Grilinhos.

Cuidado onde pisa: jararaquinha não avis.en: Watch your step: little vipers don't give warnings. I do. And challenges!

Para o sul tem um ramal que dá no Mangue.en: To the south there's a branch path to the Manguezal. Without the Machete, the vines won't let you by.

Estrada boa é estrada com roda de capoei.en: A good road is a road with a capoeira roda in the middle. Step into the roda!

Você ginga torto, mas ginga..en: Your ginga's crooked, but it's ginga.

As saliências daqui só se pulam para bai.en: The ledges here only go down. To come back, go around by the Manguezal trail.

Alto lá! A Usina Velha está em \"reforma.en: Hold it! The Old Power Plant is under "renovation". A Rust Cartel renovation!

O chefe vai me reformar….en: The boss is going to renovate me…

Eu só vigio portão. Quem manda lá dentro.en: I just guard the gate. The one in charge inside is Lieutenant Lata.

Criança não entra em obra do Cartel. Nem.en: No kids allowed on a Cartel work site. No adults either. Nobody!

Tá, entra. Mas limpe os pés..en: Fine, go in. But wipe your feet.

Estamos levando as criaturas de Trovão e.en: We're hauling off the Thunder creatures in cages. Oops. I didn't say anything.

Esta salinha é do Cartel. A alavanca tam.en: This little room belongs to the Cartel. So does the lever. So does the air!

Pode respirar. Só um pouco..en: You can breathe. Just a little.

A alavanca solta a grade da sala leste..en: The lever releases the gate in the east room. Not that I care anymore.

Subiu a escada errada, mocinho. Ou mocin.en: Wrong staircase, young man. Or young lady. I can't see well in this mask.

Enxerguei a derrota direitinho..en: I saw my defeat just fine.

Lá em cima as passarelas têm buraco. Que.en: Upstairs the catwalks have holes. Fall through and you land in the storeroom.

Patrulha do salão dos geradores! Você te.en: Generator hall patrol! Got a badge? Then you've got a battle.

Meu crachá era de papelão mesmo..en: My badge was just cardboard anyway.

A chave geral fica no porão. A tenente g.en: The main switch is in the basement. The lieutenant kept the control with her.

O Cartel paga hora extra para quem derru.en: The Cartel pays overtime for taking down intruders. Come here, my overtime!

Vou ficar devendo no banco de horas..en: Guess I'll owe hours on my timesheet.

Os depósitos trancados? Só caindo pelas.en: The locked storerooms? Only by falling through the catwalks. First-class engineering.

Daqui você não passa! A tenente Lata est.en: You're not getting past here! Lieutenant Lata is busy counting cages.

Uma jaula a mais, uma a menos….en: One cage more, one cage less…

A porta da sala de controle é elétrica..en: The control room door is electric. Without the main switch, not even the lieutenant can get out. Don't tell her.

Olhe para o chão de grade. Onde tem bura.en: Look at the grate floor. Where there's a hole, the iron is darker.

Eu tenho medo de altura e me puseram na.en: I'm scared of heights and they put me on the catwalk. I'm taking it out on you!

Agora tenho medo de você também..en: Now I'm scared of you too.

Se cair no buraco, pule a mureta do depó.en: If you fall through a hole, hop over the storeroom's low wall to get out.

O porão é úmido, escuro e cheio de bicho.en: The basement is damp, dark and full of critters that zap you. I love it. You won't.

As criaturas nas jaulas são daqui mesmo..en: The creatures in the cages are from around here. The Cartel sells them as "living batteries". Nasty, right?

Tire a mão da chave geral! Essa chave é.en: Hands off the main switch! That switch has belonged to the Cartel since the day before yesterday!

Ligou a chave? Então a porta de cima des.en: You flipped the switch? Then the door upstairs unlocked. The lieutenant's going to kill me.

Guarda das jaulas! Ninguém solta bicho n.en: Cage guard! Nobody frees a critter on my shift!

Quando a Usina voltar a funcionar, esses.en: When the Power Plant's running again, these critters will leave singing. Honestly, I'm kind of glad.

Então é você que anda amassando os meus.en: So you're the one denting my goons. I'm Lieutenant Lata, of the Rust Cartel, and I don't dent easy!

Amassou… Lata velha é assim: faz barulho.en: Dented… That's old tin for you: lots of noise, then it bends.

Encalhei aqui na maré baixa. Já que você.en: I got stranded here at low tide. Since you're here, let's battle till the tide comes in!

A maré subiu foi para você..en: The tide came in for you.

Na estação fria as baleias entram na baí.en: In the cold season the whales come into the bay. Paddle slowly and keep your mouth shut.

Onda hoje não tem. Tem treinador. Serve!.en: No waves today. But there's a trainer. That'll do!

Para o leste fica a Ilha do Farol. A Cap.en: To the east is Ilha do Farol. The Harbor Office only lets you through with the Star badge.

A Ilhota do Meio é o meu pico secreto! Q.en: Ilhota do Meio is my secret spot! I mean, it was secret.

Estrelinha evolui com Pedra Maré. Tem um.en: Estrelinha evolves with a Tide Stone. There's one around here, behind the grass.

Viu as manchas escuras na água? São poço.en: See the dark patches in the water? They're deep pools. With the Dive Charm you can go down to the Sunken Reef.

Ô de canoa! Aqui na praia quem chega pag.en: Ahoy, canoe! On this beach, whoever lands pays a battle toll.

A boca do Manguezal fica ao norte, entre.en: The mouth of the Manguezal is to the north, between the rocks. Inside, the vines close everything off: bring the Machete.

Vim catar concha para a renda da Iracema.en: I came to gather shells for Iracema's lace. Found a challenge instead!

Cidade Coral é logo ao sul. Entre pelo p.en: Cidade Coral is just to the south. Come in by the north pier and don't step on the lace laid out to dry.

Aprendiz da Iracema Lua! Antes de chegar.en: Iracema Lua's apprentice! Before you get to her, untangle yourself from me.

Encanto bate forte em Ginga, Assombro e.en: Charm hits Brawl, Spook and Legend hard. And it doesn't feel Legend moves one bit.

Meu siri belisca! Meu caranguejo belisca.en: My crab pinches! My other crab pinches! I pinch!

Ai. Belisquei a derrota..en: Ow. I pinched myself a loss.

O Saveiro do cais só leva Campeão da Lig.en: The Saveiro at the dock only takes League Champions. I asked if kids ride half-price. They don't.

O farol apagou, mas o meu Vagalumim não!.en: The lighthouse went out, but my Vagalumim didn't! Look at it blink!

O Volta sumiu no farol. O ginásio está t.en: Volta disappeared into the lighthouse. The gym's been locked ever since.

O cabo do farol é área do Cartel Ferruge.en: The lighthouse point is Rust Cartel territory. You don't have an invitation. You don't even look invited.

O tenente Rebite está na sala da lantern.en: Lieutenant Rebite is in the lamp room. He hates visitors. And stairs.

Guarda do caminho do farol! Senha? Não t.en: Lighthouse path guard! Password? There's no password. It's just no.

Estamos carregando o farol de criatura d.en: We're charging the lighthouse with Thunder creatures to… ah, ask the lieutenant.

Sem a luz do farol as garças se perdem..en: Without the lighthouse light the herons get lost. Not me: I always find a challenger.

Garcinha vira Garça-Real no nível 30. Fi.en: Garcinha becomes Garça-Real at level 30. Gets all fancy and stops saying hi to you.

A praia sul tem a melhor esquerda da baí.en: The south beach has the best left in the bay. And the best surfer: me!

Na ponta da praia tem uma loca fechada p.en: At the tip of the beach there's a nook sealed by a cracked rock. They say it holds a stone that glows at night.

Pesco no escuro desde que o farol apagou.en: I've been fishing in the dark since the lighthouse went out. I've hooked a boot, a paddle and now you.

Poraquim morde na Vara Boa aqui no píer..en: Poraquim bites on a Good Rod here on the pier. It zaps the line, the rod and the fisher.

Térreo do farol: propriedade do Cartel..en: Lighthouse ground floor: Cartel property. So are the stairs. So is the step!

Pode subir. Cuidado com o degrau..en: You can go up. Mind the step.

A escada do outro lado tem grade. Solta.en: The stairs on the other side have a gate. It's released by a lever, upstairs.

Eu vigio a porta. E o salão. E você, de.en: I'm guarding the door. And the hall. And you, up close!

Tem uma menina brava subindo o farol na.en: There's an angry girl climbing the lighthouse ahead of us. Took down three of ours without breaking a sweat.

Segundo andar! Aqui o assoalho range e o.en: Second floor! Here the floorboards creak and the goons bite!

Tem um buraco no assoalho perto das caix.en: There's a hole in the floor near the crates. It drops straight into the ground-floor storeroom.

Como você passou pela grade?! Alguém mex.en: How did you get past the gate?! Someone touched the lever!

Fui eu que deixei a alavanca sem vigia….en: I'm the one who left the lever unguarded…

A escada para o terceiro andar é a do ca.en: The stairs to the third floor are the ones in the corner. The angry girl already went up.

A alavanca é minha. Eu durmo abraçado co.en: The lever is mine. I sleep hugging it!

Puxou? Então a grade do térreo subiu. O.en: You pulled it? Then the ground-floor gate went up. Rebite's going to rivet me.

Último lance antes da lanterna. Daqui só.en: Last flight before the lamp room. Only those the lieutenant calls get past here.

Lá em cima estão as jaulas. E um farolei.en: The cages are up there. And a tied-up lighthouse keeper who won't stop giving advice.

Terceiro andar! Eu contei os degraus: sã.en: Third floor! I counted the steps: there are a lot. You won't get to count the rest.

A menina de trança disse que ia \"resolv.en: The girl with the braid said she'd "handle it herself". Nobody handles Rebite alone.

Às ordens, tenente! Vou parafusar este i.en: At your orders, Lieutenant! I'll bolt this intruder to the floor!

Minha vez! Ninguém encosta nas jaulas do.en: My turn! Nobody touches the lieutenant's cages!

Tenente Rebite, Cartel Ferrugem. Eu pren.en: Lieutenant Rebite, Rust Cartel. I fasten things in place. You're out of place.

Soltou… tudo soltou. Odeio quando solta..en: Loose… everything came loose. I hate it when things come loose.

Se você não passa nem por mim, o tenente.en: If you can't even get past me, the lieutenant up there will use you as a mop. Show me what you've learned!

Tá. Você serve. Não espalha..en: Okay. You'll do. Don't spread it around.

Quem vem lá? Ah, um lampião com um trein.en: Who goes there? Oh, a lantern with a trainer attached. Battle!

Apagou. Eu, não o lampião..en: Out like a light. Me, not the lantern.

A escada que desce fica no nordeste. A s.en: The stairs down are in the northeast. The ledge in the upper hall is only for coming back.

Achei ouro! Não, espera, é só o seu lamp.en: I struck gold! No, wait, it's just your lantern shining. Consolation battle!

Rocha rachada esconde loca com tesouro..en: Cracked rocks hide nooks with treasure. Without Rock Smash, all you can do is look and sigh.

Shhh! Estou contando Morcegão. Você espa.en: Shhh! I'm counting Morcegões. You scared off forty-two. You'll make up for them in battle!

Morcegão só evolui quando gosta muito do.en: Morcegão only evolves when it really likes its trainer. A needy bat, who knew.

Medalha de espeleologia: falta só vencer.en: Caving badge: all I need is to beat a trainer in the dark!

O Noitim daqui tem olho de lua. Dizem qu.en: The Noitim around here have moon eyes. They say they see what you'll do before you do.

Este salão é meu garimpo. Pisou, pagou:.en: This hall is my dig. Step in, pay up: in battle!

O poço lá do meio tem uma ilhota. Só de.en: The pool in the middle has an islet. Canoe only, and with a lantern lit so you don't paddle in circles.

Desço à gruta buscar minério para a forj.en: I come down into the cave for ore for the Vila Ferrugem forge. And for a fight, when one turns up!

Minério eu acho. Vitória, hoje não..en: Ore I can find. A win, not today.

Vila Ferrugem fica depois de Serra Fumaç.en: Vila Ferrugem is past Serra Fumaça, at the bottom of the slope.

Na gruta escura eu canto e o eco respond.en: In the dark cave I sing and the echo answers: "you lose, you lose, you lose"! It's talking about you!

A saída para Serra Fumaça é ao sul daqui.en: The exit to Serra Fumaça is south of here. Follow the cold air.

Pesco no lago da gruta há tanto tempo qu.en: I've fished the cave lake so long I forgot what the sun is like. Remind me with a battle!

Com a Vara Mestra, dizem que sai um Jaú-.en: With the Master Rod, they say a Jaú-Gigante comes out of this lake. All I have is the Old one.

Até aqui embaixo nasce planta, sabia? E.en: Plants grow even down here, you know? And stubborn trainers!

Serra Fumaça tem neblina o dia todo. Dei.en: Serra Fumaça is foggy all day long. Keep your Lantern lit on your way out.

Na neblina eu observo de ouvido. E ouvi.en: In the fog I birdwatch by ear. And I heard a challenger coming!

Ouvi errado. Era um vencedor..en: I heard wrong. It was a winner.

Urutauzim finge que é galho. Sacuda as á.en: Urutauzim pretends to be a branch. Shake the thick trees at night and hear the branch complain.

Na Serra Fumaça, meu povo, quem chega te.en: Up in Serra Fumaça, my friend, whoever comes has got to rhyme: you step into the battle and I'll win it every time!

A rima quebrou no meio, o verso foi pro.en: The rhyme broke in the middle, my verse went down the drain…

A Dona Benta Sombra só conta causo verda.en: Dona Benta Sombra only tells true tales. That's what makes them scary.

Este cemitério é sossegado, meu bem. Até.en: This cemetery is peaceful, dear. Until someone steps on the flowers. You stepped on them.

Vá com Deus. E pela calçada..en: Go with God. And on the sidewalk.

O jazigo do meio tem a porta de pedra ra.en: The tomb in the middle has a cracked stone door. Someone stored an old scroll inside.

Soltei pipa na neblina e perdi a pipa, a.en: I flew a kite in the fog and lost the kite, the string and track of time. But I never lose a battle!

Tem um mirante ali adiante, mas a escada.en: There's a lookout up ahead, but the stairs collapsed. Only those who can climb creepers get up there.

Subi a serra para ver a vista. Só vi neb.en: I climbed the mountain for the view. All I saw was fog. At least I'll see a battle!

A vista daqui de baixo é ruim..en: The view from down here is lousy.

Depois do ginásio, pegue a estrada leste.en: After the gym, take the east road. Encosta da Fumaça goes down to Vila Ferrugem.

Medalha de quebra-pedra: quem passa pela.en: Rock-smashing badge: whoever gets past the first rock has to face me!

A segunda barreira fica mais adiante, ao.en: The second barrier is farther ahead, to the north. After it, it's all downhill.

Um Bem-te-viço acabou de me delatar: \"b.en: A Bem-te-viço just ratted me out: "I see you, I see you!". It saw you. Battle!

Papagaiozim evolui por amizade. Converse.en: Papagaiozim evolves through friendship. Talk to it. It talks back, with an accent.

Tropa parada, tropeiro à toa. E tropeiro.en: Herd's resting, drover's idle. And an idle drover goes looking for trouble!

Eita, coice bem dado..en: Whoa, that was a solid kick.

De noite desce Jaguatirim da mata. Arisc.en: At night Jaguatirim come down from the woods. Skittish as anything. Bring a Night Gourd.

O balcão ali de cima tem uma folha rara..en: The ledge up there has a rare leaf. I can't reach it. So I stay here, grumpy, challenging people.

Só com o Amuleto de Escalar se sobe a tr.en: Only the Climb Charm gets you up the creepers. That's a Sertão thing.

Descida boa pede ginga. Quem desce duro,.en: A good downhill calls for ginga. Go down stiff and you roll. Come sway with me!

O ginásio de Vila Ferrugem é de Ferro. G.en: The Vila Ferrugem gym is Iron type. Brawl crumples tin like nobody's business.

Cada rocha rachada tem uma surpresa. A m.en: Every cracked rock has a surprise. My surprise for you is a battle!

Quebre rocha com vontade: de vez em quan.en: Smash rocks with gusto: now and then an angry Cupinzim pops out.

Vila Ferrugem não recebe qualquer um. Pa.en: Vila Ferrugem doesn't let just anyone in. Get past my sledgehammer first!

Bem-vindo, então. O Posto fica logo na e.en: Welcome, then. The Post is right at the entrance, on your left as you come in.

No intervalo do turno eu treino. O apito.en: I train during my shift break. The whistle blew: it's break time!

O apito tocou de novo. Voltei ao trabalh.en: The whistle blew again. Back to work.

O açude ali é a nascente do Cachoeira-Vé.en: That reservoir is the source of the Cachoeira-Véu. The river warden won't let you go down unless you know how to go up.

Achei uma engrenagem de ouro! É latão pi.en: I found a gold gear! It's painted brass. I'm mad. Battle!

Latão pintado, igual a minha estratégia..en: Painted brass, just like my strategy.

O sucateiro da vila troca Engrenagem Vel.en: The town junk dealer trades Old Gears for good stuff. There's one lying near the boulder.

Na roda de Vila Ferrugem o berimbau é de.en: In the Vila Ferrugem roda, the berimbau is made of rebar! Step in!

Preguinho vira Prego-Mestre no 36. Aí el.en: Preguinho becomes Prego-Mestre at 36. Then it stops throwing rocks and starts throwing anvils.
