Eu soldo o que quebra. Hoje vou quebrar.en: I weld what breaks. Today I'll break first and weld later: your team!

Quebrei foi a cara..en: What I broke was my pride.

Lá no sul da vila tem uma loca fechada p.en: In the south of town there's a nook sealed by a cracked rock. Rock Smash will sort it out.

Minha pipa é de chapa de zinco. Não voa..en: My kite is made of sheet zinc. It doesn't fly. But my team does!

A ilhota do laguinho tem uma cuia dourad.en: The islet in the pond has a golden Gourd. I saw it through my grandpa's spyglass.

Projeto Tartaruí! Só anda nesta praia qu.en: Tartaruí Project! Only those who prove they're careful may walk this beach. Prove it in battle!

Os ninhos ficam atrás das cordas. De noi.en: The nests are behind the ropes. At night the mothers climb the sand: watch from a distance.

Aqui é proibido surfar na desova. Então.en: No surfing allowed during nesting season. So I battle. Boredom is brutal!

Na estação fria aparece Pinguinzinho per.en: In the cold season, lost Pinguinzinhos show up in the grass at the point. They come from the south, bodysurfing.

Pescar aqui não pode. Batalhar, o Projet.en: No fishing here. But the Project never banned battling!

Guaiamuque de garra azul mora nas tocas.en: Blue-clawed Guaiamuques live in the restinga burrows. They'll pinch your very thoughts.

Turno da noite ou do dia, eu vigio os ni.en: Night shift or day shift, I watch the nests! Identify yourself with a battle!

A bióloga-chefe está com um ovo que ning.en: The head biologist has an egg nobody can place. She's looking for someone she can trust.

No meu mangue, caranguejo eu cato um por.en: In my mangrove I catch crabs one by one. Trainers too!

Na andada do caranguejo ninguém cata. É.en: Nobody catches crabs during the crab walk. It's the law, it's respect, and they taste better afterward.

Psiu, devagar com esse remo! Espantou me.en: Psst, easy with that paddle! You scared my little caiman. Now it wants a fight.

Ele perdeu a vontade. Eu também..en: It lost the urge. So did I.

Manatim aparece no canal fundo, bem de v.en: Manatim turns up in the deep channel, every once in a while. Manatees are shy as can be.

O mangue é o berçário da baía! E eu sou.en: The mangrove is the bay's nursery! And I'm the nanny. A fierce nanny!

Raiz de mangue segura a lama e o cipó se.en: Mangrove roots hold the mud and vines hold the canoe. For vines, the Machete.

Atolou? Não? Então vai atolar na minha e.en: Stuck in the mud? No? Then you'll get stuck in my strategy!

Atolei eu..en: I'm the one who got stuck.

De noite o Pererecão canta tão alto que.en: At night the Pererecão sings so loud the whole mangrove loses sleep.

Estou esperando uma Garça-Real há três d.en: I've been waiting for a Garça-Real for three days. You'll do to pass the time!

Garça-Real só aparece para quem já tem n.en: Garça-Real only shows up for those who've made a name on the Costa do Sol. Come back with more badges.

Subiu a cascata? Então já é gente grande.en: Climbed the waterfall? Then you're a grown-up. Grown-up battle!

Com a Vara Mestra sai Dourado-Rei no poç.en: With the Master Rod, Dourado-Rei bites in the upper pool. Ember scales, ember temper.

Estudo as ariranhas deste rio. Elas me e.en: I study the giant otters of this river. They study me back. Today, the experiment is you!

O Andorinhão-da-Cachoeira faz ninho atrá.en: The Waterfall Swift nests behind the curtain of water. It only comes out to hunt and to show off.

Um Tucanuçu de bico em brasa pousou ali.en: A Tucanuçu with a fire-red beak landed there just now! You scared it off. Pay up in battle!

De dia, nas árvores grossas, com muita s.en: By day, in the thick trees, with a lot of luck, a Mico-Leãozim drops out. Golden as the ten o'clock sun.

Treino debaixo da queda d’água para firm.en: I train under the waterfall to steady my stance. Come see if it's steady!

Bugio-Trovão ronca lá no alto. Quando el.en: Bugio-Trovão roars up high. When it roars, the waterfall shakes.

Esta margem é reserva. Quem entra, mostr.en: This riverbank is a reserve. Whoever comes in must prove they deserve it!

A anta abre trilha no mato para todo mun.en: The tapir clears trails in the brush for everyone. Tapirinho rarely shows up in the grass by the bank.

Desço cascata de prancha! Subir é que eu.en: I ride down waterfalls on a board! Going up, I still haven't figured out. You know how? Then battle!

Vou descer de novo. De cabeça baixa..en: I'll ride down again. Head hung low.

Lá embaixo o rio cai no poço de Serra Fu.en: Down below, the river falls into the Serra Fumaça pool. Up above, it starts at the Vila Ferrugem reservoir.

(Ele faz sinal de \"batalha\" com as mão.en: (He signals "battle" with his hands. Or "shark". Better to battle.)

(Ele aponta para o fundo e desenha uma c.en: (He points to the bottom and draws a huge snake with his finger.)

Quinze insígnias e ainda tem fôlego? Vam.en: Fifteen badges and still got some breath left? Let's see how far it goes!

O paredão da trepadeira é só o começo. D.en: The creeper wall is just the beginning. Then comes the dark cave and the waterfall.

Observo o Gavião-Tupã há quarenta anos..en: I've been watching for Gavião-Tupã for forty years. It never showed up. You did. Battle!

Ele só desce do trovão para quem a Aldei.en: It only comes down from the thunder for those the Aldeia recognizes. Talk to the Shaman.

No alto do monte o vento joga capoeira c.en: At the top of the mountain the wind plays capoeira with us. I learned from it!

De noite, com sorte, um Maracajim cruza.en: At night, with luck, a Maracajim crosses the trail. By day, only its tracks.

Cada bromélia daqui é um condomínio de c.en: Every bromeliad here is an apartment building for creatures. And I'm the building manager!

Lavadeira-Dragão de asa de vitral voa so.en: The stained-glass-winged Lavadeira-Dragão flies over the pools up high. Rare. Gorgeous. Fierce.

A gruta do monte tem cristal que canta..en: The mountain cave has crystals that sing. I sing along. Badly. A battle to drown it out!

Sem Lampião a gruta não tem saída. Com L.en: Without a Lantern, the cave has no way out. With a Lantern, it has one: up.

Última curva antes da Aldeia Tupã. Quem.en: Last bend before Aldeia Tupã. Get past me, and the Shaman will greet you standing!

A Aldeia fica logo acima. A trilha da es.en: The Aldeia is just above. The trail on the left climbs even higher: that's the one to Pico Pingorama.

A Aldeia recebe bem. Mas antes mede. Dei.en: The Aldeia welcomes everyone. But first it takes their measure. Let me measure you!

O Pajé Trovão-Velho guarda a última insí.en: Shaman Trovão-Velho guards the last badge. The gym's four trials are of the four elements.

Toda história boa tem uma batalha no mei.en: Every good story has a battle in the middle. Let's write yours!

O Gavião-Tupã pousa na pedra mais alta q.en: Gavião-Tupã lands on the highest rock when the sky recognizes a true guardian.

Quando eu crescer vou ser Pajé! Hoje vou.en: When I grow up I'm gonna be a Shaman! Today I'll just be your nightmare!

Tipo Lenda só teme Geada, Encanto e outr.en: Legend type only fears Frost, Charm and other Legends. The Shaman has all the other answers.

Quem entra na rajada antes do primeiro m.en: Step into the gust before the first mast and it stops you there. That's how you reach the left plank.

Peixe bom vem com vento sul. Treinador b.en: Good fish come with the south wind. Good trainers, I reel in on the spot!

Esse escapou do anzol..en: That one slipped off the hook.

Depois do segundo mastro não tem corda n.en: After the second mast there's no rope at all: step in there and you end up in the sea.

Voaram todas… e a minha vitória também..en: They all flew away… and so did my win.

A alavanca vira os cata-ventos. A pranch.en: The lever flips the pinwheels. The plank you came up on starts blowing the other way.

Vento terral, mar liso… só falta uma bat.en: Offshore wind, glassy sea… all I need is a battle to make the day perfect!

A última corrente leva direto ao Mestre..en: The last current takes you straight to the Master. Take a deep breath and go!

Sessenta anos soltando pipa neste píer..en: Sixty years flying kites on this pier. The wind tells me everything… and it told me you were coming. Show me what you've got!

Eita! Você cortou a minha linha em pleno.en: Whoa! You cut my string right out of the sky.

Vento bom é o que empurra a gente para a.en: A good wind is the one that pushes you forward.

Meus bichinhos cabem numa caixa de fósfo.en: My little critters fit in a matchbox, but boy, do they bite!

A ponte de 3 nós sai daqui e sobe para o.en: The 3-knot bridge starts here and goes up to the northeast. Then you go all the way back: the 4-knot one is on the other side.

Não pise nas minhas amostras! Aliás, já.en: Don't step on my samples! Actually, since you climbed all the way up here, let's collect some battle data.

Resultado inesperado. Vou anotar..en: Unexpected result. I'll write that down.

A ponte de 7 nós parece atalho para a Li.en: The 7-knot bridge looks like a shortcut to Lia, doesn't it? Well, it's the last in line.

Sempre alerta! Principalmente com formig.en: Always prepared! Especially with ants in my boots.

Ponte firme fica dourada. Use as dourada.en: A bridge turns gold once it's firm. Use the golden ones to come and go without fear.

Conheço cada galho desta copa. E cada fe.en: I know every branch in this canopy. And every stinger too!

Ai! Dessa vez a ferroada foi em mim..en: Ouch! This time I'm the one who got stung.

A de 6 nós leva até a Lia. Ela tece arma.en: The 6-knot one takes you to Lia. She weaves traps in battle the same way she weaves bridges.

Passei três anos morando nesta copa para.en: I spent three years living in this canopy to understand a single spider. Let's see how long it takes you to understand my team!

Você desfez a minha teia fio por fio. Qu.en: You undid my web thread by thread. What a sight!

Toda teia começa com um fio só. Continue.en: Every web starts with a single thread. Keep weaving yours.

Quer subir na balsa? Primeiro passa pela.en: Want to board the raft? First get past my net!

Rede furada….en: Net's got a hole in it…

A balsa só encosta com o canal cheio. O.en: The raft only docks when the channel's full. The wheel in the corner fills this channel and the middle one at once.

Onda de canal é pequena, mas é minha. Bo.en: Channel waves are small, but they're mine. Wanna drop in on a battle?

O volante deste lado troca: esvazia o ca.en: The wheel on this side switches things: it drains the middle channel and fills the hall's arm. Think before you turn it.

Glub! Quer dizer: alto lá! Este volante.en: Glub! I mean: halt! This wheel is my post.

Este volante enche o canal do líder. Gir.en: This wheel fills the leader's channel. Turn it, go back through the arm while it's empty, and only then touch the other one.

Meu pai cuida das comportas. Eu cuido de.en: My dad looks after the floodgates. I look after whoever goes through them!

Se a balsa do líder está no fundo, falto.en: If the leader's raft is at the bottom, you forgot to turn the wheel in the east hall.

Última eclusa antes do capitão. Daqui ni.en: Last lock before the captain. Nobody gets past here dry!

O Marujo foi campeão de remo. Ele gosta.en: The Sailor was a rowing champion. He likes to start slow and finish in the rapids.

Remei da nascente até a foz do Rio Serei.en: I rowed from the source to the mouth of the Rio Sereia without stopping for lunch. You think a handful of floodgates will tire me out? On guard, greenhorn sailor!

Homem ao mar! E o homem sou eu….en: Man overboard! And the man is me…

Rio que corre nunca passa duas vezes pel.en: A flowing river never passes the same stone twice. Keep moving forward.

Não encoste no espelho com a mão suja! P.en: Don't touch the mirror with dirty hands! Battle first, then fiddle.

O espelho gira entre duas posições só. N.en: The mirror only turns between two positions. In both it deflects the light: what changes is which way.

A vovó me deixou tomando conta deste esp.en: Grandma left me in charge of this mirror. Nobody turns it without talking to me!

Com o raio para cima, a passagem da esqu.en: With the beam pointing up, the left passage closes. With the beam pointing down, it opens.

Estou anotando de onde vem cada raio. Vo.en: I'm noting where each beam comes from. You just walked right in front of me!

Perdi a conta e a batalha..en: Lost count and lost the battle.

A estrela deste salão fica na parede oes.en: This hall's star is on the west wall. The upper mirror needs to send the light there, not east.

Menina… menino… quem mexe em espelho alh.en: Young lady… young man… whoever messes with someone else's mirror gets seven years of battle!

Este espelho manda o raio para cima, na.en: This mirror sends the beam up to the other star, and opens the east passage while it's at it.

Abriu a cortina? Então a Iracema vai gos.en: Opened the curtain? Then Iracema's going to like you. But first, get past me!

A Iracema confunde a cabeça do adversári.en: Iracema confuses her opponent's head and only then strikes. Bring fruit that cures charm.

Renda se faz com paciência, luz boa e mã.en: Lace takes patience, good light and a steady hand. So do battles. Have a seat… or rather, stay standing: let's weave some threads!

Ai, que beleza de ponto! Você arrematou.en: Oh, what a lovely stitch! You finished off the battle without leaving a loose thread.

Luz não se prende. A gente só mostra o c.en: You can't catch light. We just show it the way.

Não pise nos cabos! Quer dizer… pise em.en: Don't step on the cables! I mean… don't step on me either: battle me!

A ponte daqui só fica estendida enquanto.en: The bridge here only stays extended while switch 1 sends it power. Flip the switch and it retracts.

O vô Volta disse que eu sou o relé mais.en: Grandpa Volta says I'm the fastest relay on the island!

O relé está sem corrente agora, mas dá p.en: The relay has no current right now, but you can leave it pointed at the east bridge. Then go back and flip switch 1.

Pesco poraquê com vara de bambu seco. Sa.en: I fish for eels with a dry bamboo rod. Know why? You're about to find out!

Agora o relé tem corrente. Vire-o para a.en: Now the relay has current. Turn it toward the upper line and the north hall bridge extends.

Conto os relâmpagos do alto do farol. Ho.en: I count the lightning from the top of the lighthouse. Today I'll count your stumbles!

O piso de teste só dá choque enquanto a.en: The test floor only shocks you while switch 3 sends current to it. Flip the switch and Volta's bridge extends.

Eureca! Um desafiante que entende de cir.en: Eureka! A challenger who understands circuits! I'm Volta: I light the lighthouse, fix radios and zap distracted trainers. Flip the switch, here comes the discharge!

Curto-circuito geral! Mas que beleza de.en: Total short circuit! But what a beautiful blackout…

Energia boa é a que chega aonde precisa..en: Good energy is the kind that gets where it's needed. Yours does.

Q-quem está aí? Ah, é gente. Então batal.en: W-who's there? Oh, it's a person. Then battle me, so I forget I'm scared!

A lamparina de pé ali do canto acende a.en: The standing lamp in the corner lights yours. Without light, you can't tell where the floor is really floor.

No escuro desta sala / fiz um verso de a.en: In the dark of this old room / I wrote a verse to chill your bones: / whoever walks without a lamp / ends up down below, alone!

Perdi a rima e a batalha..en: Lost the rhyme and the battle.

O óleo acaba antes da porta. No fim da f.en: The oil runs out before the door. At the end of the bottom row there's another lamp: it's straight ahead, go on.

Psiu! Estou esperando a assombração da m.en: Shh! I'm waiting for the midnight ghost. Until it shows up, you'll do.

A assombrada fui eu..en: I'm the one who got spooked.

Corredor comprido para o leste? É beco..en: Long corridor to the east? Dead end. The good path goes up just two steps and turns west.

Passou pelas três salas? Então escute o.en: Made it through all three rooms? Then hear the last tale before Dona Benta: the tale of your defeat!

Esse causo acabou diferente..en: That tale had a different ending.

A Dona Benta derruba a sua precisão com.en: Dona Benta knocks down your accuracy with mist and bad omens. Moves that never miss are worth their weight in gold.

Senta que lá vem história… Era uma vez u.en: Gather round for a story… Once upon a time, a challenger crossed the darkness without falling. How does it end? We're about to find out!

E viveram assombrados para sempre… eu, p.en: And they lived haunted ever after… me, at least. What a good tale you gave me!

Medo é só uma história mal contada..en: Fear is just a story told badly.

Crachá, capacete e batalha: sem os três.en: ID badge, hard hat and a battle: without all three, nobody rides the belt!

A esteira da porta está descendo. A engr.en: The belt by the door runs downward. The red gear in the corner sorts that out.

Tudo que cai da esteira é meu. Você caiu.en: Everything that falls off the belt is mine. Did you fall?

A esteira do meio parece o caminho mais.en: The middle belt looks like the shortest path. It is: the shortest path to the press.

Subiu pela azul? Esperta… esperto… agora.en: Came up the blue one? Clever… now take this hammering!

A engrenagem vermelha deste andar invert.en: The red gear on this floor flips the circuit again. That's the only way the northwest belt goes up.

Escalo chaminé de fábrica nas horas vaga.en: I climb factory chimneys in my spare time. You're my spare time!

Lá no mezanino tem a última engrenagem a.en: Up on the mezzanine is the last blue gear. If you don't turn it, Bigorna's belt pushes you right back.

Trinta anos de chão de fábrica. Ninguém.en: Thirty years on the factory floor. Nobody gets to the engineer without passing my quality control!

A Bigorna endurece a defesa antes de bat.en: Bigorna toughens her defense before she strikes. Special moves get through better than brute force.

Projetei cada parafuso desta fábrica, e.en: I designed every bolt in this factory, and you took my circuit apart in ten minutes. Now I want to see your battle design. Start the machines!

Parada geral! Meu projeto tinha uma falh.en: Full stop! My design had a flaw: it didn't account for you.

Toda engrenagem importa. Até a menor..en: Every gear matters. Even the smallest.

Cuidado onde pisa, que aqui tudo brota!.en: Watch where you step, everything sprouts here! Including battles.

Viu o cipó correndo pela fila de cima? E.en: See the vine creeping along the top row? It shuts the little corner door. If it closes, just spray the pot.

Estou medindo quanto o cipó cresce por p.en: I'm measuring how much the vine grows per step. Stand still… or better, battle standing still!

Batalha não conta passo. O cipó do norte.en: Battles don't count as steps. The north vine only wakes on the 10th step after the pot and closes the way up on the 16th.

Achou que por aqui tinha saída? Tem é eu.en: Thought there was an exit this way? There's just me!

Este lado é beco. A saída de verdade fic.en: This side is a dead end. The real exit is in the top corner, past the middle row.

Montei acampamento no canto mais sossega.en: I set up camp in the quietest corner of the greenhouse. Until you showed up!

O vaso do meio tem dois lados. Só o lado.en: The middle pot has two sides. Only the top side gets you to the exit in time.

Quarenta anos de mato e nunca vi desafia.en: Forty years in the bush and I've never seen a challenger get past the vines so quickly. Let me take a closer look!

A Dona Buriti cura a equipe com seiva e.en: Dona Buriti heals her team with sap and herbal tonic mid-fight. Don't let the battle drag on.

Menino, menina… senta aí que eu vou cont.en: Young man, young lady… sit down and I'll tell you: every plant has a poison and a remedy. Let's see which one you brought!

Arre! Você é erva boa. Dessas que curam..en: Goodness! You're a good herb. The healing kind.

Raiz forte não se vê. Cuide da sua..en: Strong roots can't be seen. Take care of yours.

Norte: BOSQUE ALTO, a cidade nas copas.\.en:
North: BOSQUE ALTO, the city in the treetops.
South: good luck.

CLAREIRA DOS SABIÁS\nQuem se perde na ma.en:
CLAREIRA DOS SABIÁS
If you're lost in the woods, follow the song: the sabiá always sings toward the sunrise.
(East, friend. Sunrise is east.)

Shhh! Está ouvindo? Sabiá-laranjeira. Ca.en: Shhh! Hear that? A rufous-bellied thrush. It's been singing since five in the morning, nonstop.

As árvores de tronco grosso escondem cri.en: Thick-trunked trees hide creatures. By day, Saguinhos drop out; at night, only things that see in the dark.

Ah, a saída? Pelo leste e depois para o.en: Oh, the exit? East, then north. Going west you just walk in circles — speaking from experience.

TRILHA DO IPÊ\nNorte: Vila Caiçara · Sul.en:
TRILHA DO IPÊ
North: Vila Caiçara · South: Vila Jacarandá
Tip: hop down the ledges to get down faster.

CAMPOS DE RESTINGA\nOeste: Vila Caiçara.en:
CAMPOS DE RESTINGA
West: Vila Caiçara · East: Mata dos Sabiás
Cashew tree with a thick trunk? Give it a shake. (The town is not responsible for whatever falls out.)

TRILHA DOS CIPÓS\nOeste: Bosque Alto · L.en:
TRILHA DOS CIPÓS
West: Bosque Alto · East: Gruta do Eco → Porto Sereia
Thick vines don't come undone: they get cut. Bring the Machete and a partner who knows how to use it.

Esses cipós cresceram numa noite só. Mat.en: These vines grew in a single night. Thick forest is like that: blink, and it's braided.

O Facão corta, mas quem maneja é a criat.en: The Machete cuts, but the creature does the swinging: it has to be Grass, Bug or Brawl type.

O Riacho da Piaba faz jus ao nome: é jog.en: Riacho da Piaba lives up to its name: cast your line and up comes a Piabinha.

De noite a margem enche de Pererequinha.en: At night the bank fills up with Pererequinhas and Vagalumims. Looks like a June festival.

Dizem que lá dentro da Gruta do Eco tem.en: They say deep inside Gruta do Eco there's a whiskered catfish that lives in the dark. Mandizinho, it's called.

Troféus da {RIVAL}: \"2º lugar — Corrida.en: {RIVAL}'s trophies: "2nd place — Sack Race", "2nd place — Kite Contest", "1st place — Stubbornness" (her grandpa made that one).

Um programa de culinária: moqueca em 12.en: A cooking show: moqueca in 12 steps. Step 1 is "have a fish".

Um baú com cheiro de maresia. Dentro, ve.en: A chest that smells of sea breeze. Inside, patched sails and a broken paddle.

A {RIVAL} acordou antes do galo e saiu d.en: {RIVAL} woke up before the rooster and left saying she was going to "become a legend".

Puxou a mim. Eu também ia ser lenda, mas.en: She takes after me. I was going to be a legend too, but it was too much work.

Se cruzar com a minha filha na estrada,.en: If you run into my daughter on the road, remind her to eat.

E você também, {JOGADOR}: batalha de bar.en: You too, {JOGADOR}: battling on an empty stomach is no good.

Um tacho de cocada borbulha devagar. Mel.en: A pot of cocada bubbles slowly. Better not stick a finger in.

Água de filtro de barro: a mais gelada d.en: Water from a clay filter: the coldest in Pingorama, Vó Zica swears.

Na máquina de costura, uma colcha de ret.en: On the sewing machine, a half-finished patchwork quilt. One patch has a Tamanduí print.

Um cesto de novelos. Um deles se mexe… a.en: A basket of yarn. One of the balls is moving… oh, no, it's just the cat sleeping.

O feijão está no fogo. O cheiro de louro.en: The beans are on the stove. The smell of bay leaves fills the whole house.

Suco de caju, doce de leite e um bilhete.en: Cashew juice, dulce de leche and a note: "The pudding is for AFTER lunch."

O jornal do meio-dia: \"Pescadores de Po.en: The noon news: "Porto Sereia fishers complain: the Old Power Plant has been throwing sparks."

O oratório da família. Tem uma fitinha a.en: The family shrine. There's a ribbon tied on for every trip that went well.

No microscópio, uma escama de Piabinha b.en: Under the microscope, a Piabinha scale shines like a brand-new coin.

Pastas e mais pastas: \"Migração dos Pip.en: Folders upon folders: "Pipirin Migration", "Why Gambazinho Plays Dead", "Cornmeal Cake Recipe".

O terminal de pesquisa da professora. Na.en: The professor's research terminal. On screen: "Field Journal — 180 species expected, 12 recorded. Help."

Frascos com sementes de ipê. Cada um tem.en: Jars of ipê seeds. Each one has a date and a little smiley face.

Gibis do Capitão Jangada, um atlas de Pi.en: Captain Jangada comics, an atlas of Pingorama and a creature sticker album.

Falta só a figurinha do Uirapuru. Sempre.en: Only the Uirapuru sticker is missing. It's always the Uirapuru that's missing.

Passa a reprise do Torneio do Pico Pingo.en: A rerun of the Pico Pingorama Tournament is on.

\"…e a Guardiã Iara Costa vence mais uma.en: "…and Guardian Iara Costa wins once again without getting her hair wet!"

Roupas de frio que nunca saem do baú. Aq.en: Winter clothes that never leave the chest. This is the Costa do Sol, after all.

VILA JACARANDÁ\n\"Onde a sombra é roxa e.en:
VILA JACARANDÁ
"Where the shade is purple and the coffee is strong."

LABORATÓRIO DA PROFª IPÊ AMARELO\nPesqui.en:
PROF. IPÊ AMARELO'S LAB
Pingorama creature research. Knock before entering (nobody knocks).

Casa da Vó Zica.\nVendem-se cocadas (qua.en:
Vó Zica's house.
Cocadas for sale (when there are leftovers).

Casa da família da {RIVAL}.\n\"Cuidado c.en:
Home of {RIVAL}'s family.
"Beware of the champion" (she painted the sign herself).

A vó diz que criatura feliz luta melhor..en: Grandma says a happy creature fights better.

A minha Cotiazinha é tão feliz que dorme.en: My Cotiazinha is so happy she falls asleep in the middle of battle.

Varetas de bambu, papel de seda e um pot.en: Bamboo sticks, tissue paper and a pot of flour glue. A kite shaped like a Gaviãozão is almost done.

Previsão do tempo: \"Vento nordeste, óti.en: Weather forecast: "Northeast wind, great for kites and terrible for hairdos."

Rabiola comprida deixa a pipa firme; rab.en: A long tail keeps a kite steady; a short tail makes it jumpy.

Com criatura é igual: cada uma tem sua p.en: Creatures are the same: each one has its own personality, and it changes their stats.

Depois do ginásio daqui, o caminho é pel.en: After the gym here, the way forward is through Campos de Restinga, to the east.

Leve Fumaça de Andiroba se enjoar de tan.en: Bring Andiroba Smoke if you get sick of Calanguinhos jumping at your shins.

O fogão fica aceso dia e noite: ovo gost.en: The stove stays lit day and night: eggs like warmth and Seu Aroeira likes coffee.

Um ninho com três ovos pintadinhos. Um d.en: A nest with three speckled eggs. One of them just gave a little hop!

Um ninho forrado de paina. O ovo daqui é.en: A nest lined with kapok fluff. The egg here is green with stripes.

Ninho vazio, ainda morno. Alguém nasceu.en: An empty nest, still warm. Someone hatched not long ago.

Cadernos de anotação: \"Ovo nº 412 — cho.en: Notebooks: "Egg no. 412 — hatched singing." "Egg no. 413 — was a potato. My mistake."

Um cesto de frutos para os filhotes: pit.en: A basket of fruit for the hatchlings: pitanga, cashew and acerola.

VILA CAIÇARA GYM

"Who knows the wind never paddles in vain."

A alavanca do deque nordeste vira os cat.en: The lever on the northeast deck flips the pinwheels on both north planks at once.

Seis vão com você; o resto descansa no V.en: Six go with you; the rest relax in the Gourd Keep, feet up.

Venho curar meu Quero-querinho todo dia..en: I come to heal my Quero-querinho every day.

Ele não está machucado. É que ele gosta.en: He's not hurt. He just likes the machine's little tune.

Chegou freguesia! Olha a cuia fresquinha.en: Customers! Fresh Gourds here, and tea that'll perk up even a Preguicim!

Mel Puro tira o veneno da criatura na ho.en: Pure Honey cures a creature's poison on the spot.

Tira também a fome do treinador, mas aí.en: It cures a trainer's hunger too, but then Dona Cotinha charges double.

VILA CAIÇARA
"Here the wind is boss, and we fly kites."

VILA CAIÇARA GYM
Leader: Master Gaivota — "the old man who talks to the wind".

VIVEIRO DO SEU AROEIRA\nCuida-se de ovo,.en:
SEU AROEIRA'S AVIARY
We care for eggs, hatchlings and hungry visitors.

POSTO GUARDIÃO\nCura grátis para criatur.en:
GUARDIAN POST
Free healing for creatures and free advice for trainers.

CAIÇARA SHOP
Gourds, teas and fresh gossip.

Casa dos Pipeiros.\nNão puxe a linha!.en:
The Kite Fliers' house.
Don't pull the string!

Alto lá! O vento nos Campos de Restinga.en: Hold it! The wind on Campos de Restinga today would rip off even a glued-on hat. Master Gaivota told me to keep the gate shut: only those with the Feather Badge who can read the wind get through.

Minha pipa subiu tanto que um Pipirim fe.en: My kite went up so high a Pipirim built a nest in it.

Agora eu não tenho coragem de puxar a li.en: Now I don't have the heart to reel it in.

Criaturas do tipo Vento voam por cima do.en: Wind-type creatures fly right over Earth moves. They don't feel a thing!

Mas um bom choque do tipo Trovão derruba.en: But a good Thunder-type zap brings down any cocky little bird.

O Mestre Gaivota perdeu de mim no dominó.en: Master Gaivota lost to me at dominoes in 1974.

Desde então ele só batalha. Diz que no v.en: Ever since, he only battles. Says nobody can cheat the wind.

Tá vendo aquela ilhota lá embaixo, na en.en: See that islet down there in the cove? There's something on it.

Só chega quem rema. E canoa, por aqui, s.en: Only paddlers get there. And around here, a canoe only moves with a River-type creature pulling it.

Novela das seis. A mocinha acabou de des.en: The six o'clock soap opera. The heroine just found out the villain is her own twin brother. Again.

Um baú de brinquedos: pião, peteca e um.en: A toy chest: a spinning top, a shuttlecock and a confiscated slingshot.

Quando eu era menino, também me perdi na.en: When I was a boy, I got lost in Mata dos Sabiás too.

Fiquei três dias comendo pitanga. Melhor.en: I spent three days eating pitangas. Best vacation of my life.

Plantas de pontes: \"ponte pênsil\", \"p.en: Bridge blueprints: "suspension bridge", "plank bridge", "bridge I haven't invented yet".

Ferramentas: serrote, formão, plaina e u.en: Tools: a handsaw, a chisel, a plane and a hammer with a name engraved on it: "The Persuader".

O mestre só fala da ponte da casa-da-árv.en: The master only talks about the treehouse bridge. He falls asleep thinking about rope and wakes up thinking about rope.

Corda de Cipó vende na Venda do Galho. T.en: The Branch Shop sells Vine Rope. Three coils would sort out his life — and mine.

Trouxe minha cadeira de balanço para con.en: I brought my rocking chair in to be fixed in March.

Não disse de que ano. Erro meu..en: I didn't say which year. My mistake.

Caixinhas de fósforo furadas, cada uma c.en: Matchboxes with air holes, each with a kale leaf and a name: "Fifi", "Lulu", "Her Majesty".

Documentário: \"A mariposa-bruxa só visi.en: A documentary: "The witch moth only visits those with a light on and patience." Makes you sleepy, and makes you want one.

Novelos de seda crua. Macios que só..en: Skeins of raw silk. Soft as can be.

No ginásio da Dona Seda as pontes de tei.en: In Dona Seda's gym, the web bridges snap if you step on them out of order.

Olhe os nós antes de pisar: um nó, dois.en: Look at the knots before you step: one knot, two knots, three knots. Webs are math.

Lagartim vira Casulim no nível 7, e Casu.en: Lagartim becomes Casulim at level 7, and Casulim becomes Bruxaluz at 10.

É a evolução mais rápida de Pingorama. P.en: It's the fastest evolution in Pingorama. Too bad our debts don't work that way.

"A spider's patience, an ant's courage."

Quem pisa numa teia fora da ordem cai na.en: Step on a web out of order and you fall into the safety net and start over from the entrance.

Saí da Mata dos Sabiás com a equipe toda.en: I came out of Mata dos Sabiás with my whole team poisoned by a Coralzinha.

Mel Puro, minha gente. Nunca mais entro.en: Pure Honey, folks. I'm never going into the woods without Pure Honey again.

Meu Lagartim virou Casulim e agora só sa.en: My Lagartim turned into Casulim and now all it knows is how to harden.

A Guardiã disse para ter paciência: no n.en: The Guardian told me to be patient: at level 10 it spreads its wings.

Bem-vindo à Venda do Galho! Aqui o preço.en: Welcome to the Branch Shop! Prices here don't go up: the customers do, by the stairs.

Corda de Cipó tira a gente de caverna nu.en: Vine Rope gets you out of a cave in a single tug.

O Mestre Imbuia anda atrás de três rolos.en: Master Imbuia is looking for three coils to fix the bridge. I'm sure not lending him mine.

Leader: Dona Seda — "the weaver who never loses the thread".

Dona Graúna's house.

Climb the stairs slowly: hurt creatures will thank you.

BRANCH SHOP
Whatever falls off the tree, we sell. Except coconuts, which don't grow here.

Master Imbuia's Workshop.
Bridges, ladders and rocking chair repairs.

The Cocoon Keepers' house.
Quiet: someone's turning into a butterfly.

Aqui ninguém pisa no chão depois que cho.en: Nobody here touches the ground after it rains: it's walkways all the way!

Minha vó diz que no tempo dela se ia de.en: My grandma says in her day people got around by vine. My grandma tells a lot of stories.

Inseto não aguenta fogo, nem bicada, nem.en: Bugs can't handle fire, pecking or rocks. Ember, Wind and Stone take care of Dona Seda.

Agora, se a sua parceira for de Mata ou.en: Now, if your partner is Grass or Mind… bring plenty of tea.

A Trilha dos Cipós, a leste, fechou de v.en: Trilha dos Cipós, to the east, got completely closed off after the rains.

Só passa quem tem o Amuleto do Facão — e.en: Only those with the Machete Charm can get through — and Dona Seda only hands hers to someone carrying the Cocoon Badge.

Canteiro de terra fofa é banco: você dep.en: A soft-soil garden bed is a bank: you deposit one fruit and withdraw a handful.

Água fresca do filtro de barro. Não tem.en: Fresh water from the clay filter. No fridge can match it.

TCHIBUM! O vento jogou você no mar.\nUm.en:
SPLASH! The wind tossed you into the sea.
A fisher hauled you back to the entrance of the pier.

Os cata-ventos das pranchas do norte vir.en: The pinwheels on the north planks flipped!

A prancha da direita agora sopra para o.en: The right plank now blows south, and the left one blows north.

A prancha da direita voltou a soprar par.en: The right plank is blowing north again, and the left one south.

O mar bate forte nas estacas do píer. Aq.en: The sea pounds the pier's pilings. You can only walk on the planks here.

Uma corrente de vento varre as tábuas. Q.en: A current of wind sweeps across the planks. Step on it and you go along for the ride.

CRACK! The {n} web snapped under your feet.
The safety net sent you back to the entrance. The bridge to cross now is the {proxima} one.

Não tem galho nenhum ali! Você despencou.en: There's no branch over there! You tumbled into the safety net and ended up back at the entrance.

A teia de {n} ficou firme! Agora a de {p.en: The {n} web held firm! Now the {proxima} one will hold.

Uma ponte de teia com {n} dourados. Está.en: A {n} web bridge, its knots all golden. It's as taut as a guitar string.

Uma ponte de teia com {n}. Os fios estão.en: A {n} web bridge. The threads are stretched tight, ready for your weight.

Uma ponte de teia com {n}. Os fios ainda.en: A {n} web bridge. The threads are still slack.

Um casulo morno, do tamanho de uma jaca..en: A warm cocoon the size of a jackfruit. Something is moving inside… better let it sleep.

Daqui se vê o chão da floresta, lá embai.en: From here you can see the forest floor far below, and a safety net halfway down.

O volante range e a água corre pelas com.en: The wheel creaks and water rushes through the floodgates.

As comportas voltaram ao começo enquanto.en:
The floodgates reset while you were away.
A sailor took you back to the gym entrance.

A balsa está encalhada no fundo do canal.en: The raft is stuck at the bottom of the channel. It only rises to the dock when the channel's full.

Dá para ver uma passarela baixa debaixo.en: You can see a low walkway under the water. With the channel empty, it would be exposed.

A água do canal corre forte e funda. Sem.en: The channel water runs fast and deep. Without the raft, no dice.

O leito do canal fica dois metros abaixo.en: The channel bed is two meters below the floor, slick with algae. Only the low walkway crosses it.

A cortina de renda do salão da líder se.en: The lace curtain to the leader's hall opened!

Uma estrela apagou e a cortina de renda.en: A star went out and the lace curtain closed again.

Os espelhos voltaram ao lugar enquanto v.en:
The mirrors went back into place while you were away.
Iracema sent you back to the start of the hall.

Um raio de luz forte demais para encarar.en: A beam of light too bright to look at. Only turning a mirror will move it out of the way.

Uma cortina de renda grossa fecha o salã.en:
A thick lace curtain closes off the leader's hall.
It only opens with both crystal stars lit ({n} of 2).

A estrela de cristal brilha com a luz do.en: The crystal star shines with the light from the stained glass.

Uma estrela de cristal apagada, presa à.en: An unlit crystal star, fixed to the wall. It needs light.

Um vitral amarelo. A luz do sol entra po.en: A yellow stained-glass window. Sunlight comes through it in a single beam, straight as bobbin-lace thread.

O Faroleiro deixou tudo ligado depois da.en: The Lighthouse Keeper left everything on after your win. The switch doesn't even need an owner anymore.

CLAC! A corrente agora segue para {para}.en:
CLACK! The current now flows to {para}.
The branch that was on lost its power.

CLAC! A chave {n} agora aponta para {par.en:
CLACK! Switch {n} now points to {para}.
But no current reaches here: nothing changed… for now.

ZZZT! O piso de teste está eletrificado..en: ZZZT! The test floor is electrified. The hair on your arms stands up just from getting close.

A ponte elétrica está recolhida: a lâmpa.en: The electric bridge is retracted: the lamp beside it is red. This branch has no power.

Um vão fundo, cheio de cabos e isoladore.en: A deep gap, full of cables and insulators. Far below, the sea pounds the base of the lighthouse.

Os lustres do sobrado estão acesos desde.en: The manor's chandeliers have been lit since your win. The lamp can rest.

NHEEEC… PLOFT! Um alçapão se abriu debai.en:
CREEEAK… FWUMP! A trapdoor opened under your feet.
You slid down a dusty chute to the start of the room, and the lamp went out.

A chama da lamparina está fraquinha….en: The lamp's flame is getting weak…

PSSSSH! A prensa de vapor soltou um jato.en:
PSSSSH! The steam press blew a jet right in your face.
The workers carried you, coughing, back to the entrance.

As esteiras estão paradas desde a sua vi.en: The belts have been stopped since your win. The gear just spins freely.

CLANC-CLANC! Todas as esteiras de seta v.en: CLANK-CLANK! All the red-arrow belts switched direction.

CLANC-CLANC! Todas as esteiras de seta a.en: CLANK-CLANK! All the blue-arrow belts switched direction.

PSSSSH! Você pisou bem debaixo da prensa.en:
PSSSSH! You stepped right under the steam press.
The workers carried you back to the entrance.

Uma esteira do circuito vermelho. Ela ca.en: A conveyor belt on the red circuit. It carries whatever touches it in the direction the arrow points.

Uma esteira do circuito azul. Ela carreg.en: A conveyor belt on the blue circuit. It carries whatever touches it in the direction the arrow points.

A prensa de vapor bufa a cada dois segun.en: The steam press puffs every two seconds. Better not stand under it.

O extrato de raiz amarga perfuma a estuf.en: The bitter root extract perfumes the greenhouse. The vines have been asleep since your win.

Você borrifou o extrato de raiz amarga..en:
You sprayed the bitter root extract. All the vines in the greenhouse withered…
but they're already sprouting again. Every step counts!

Um cipó grosso e vivo fechou a passagem..en:
A thick, living vine has closed the passage.
Without the Machete and a creature that knows how to use it, only the extract from the pots makes the vine wither.

{n} cortou o cipó com o Facão! Ele murch.en: {n} cut the vine with the Machete! It withered down to the root… and it's already starting to sprout again.
